content:
Fundraiser by Craig De Meillon : Support Craig’s Mission to Aid Nepal Tibet Mudslide Victims
Craig’s campaign funds deployment, equipment, and communications for mudslide rescue work
Craig De Meillon is organizing this fundraiser.
My name is Craig De Meillon, and I am based in Miami, Florida. I work in safety and emergency management and am a trained firefighter and EMT with professional experience responding to disasters, emergencies, and humanitarian situations.
I am raising these funds as an independent volunteer to support my deployment to the areas affected by the recent mudslides and flooding in Nepal near the China border. I am not a family member or representative of anyone affected by the disaster, nor am I collecting these funds on behalf of a government agency or other organization. I am responding independently based on my emergency-response experience and my ability to bring useful communications and search equipment into the field.
The funds raised will be used primarily to cover the direct costs of my deployment and emergency-response work. This includes my airfare and ground transportation to and within the affected region, accommodation and essential field logistics, food and other necessary expenses while deployed, and emergency-response equipment and supplies.
A significant part of the funding will also be used for search and communications capabilities. This may include purchasing or renting drones that can be used to conduct aerial searches, assess inaccessible areas, locate people who may be stranded or missing, and help response teams understand conditions on the ground. Funds will also be used for satellite communications equipment and associated Starlink service costs so that I can maintain reliable communications in areas where local telecommunications infrastructure may be damaged, unavailable, or overloaded.
Where practical, I may purchase essential supplies locally rather than transporting them from the United States. This allows funds to be used more efficiently and can also support local businesses and responders.
The primary beneficiary of this fundraiser is me, Craig De Meillon, because the funds are being raised to cover the actual expenses I incur while independently deploying and carrying out this emergency-response work. The money is not being raised for personal profit or general living expenses. It is intended to offset the costs directly associated with the mission, including travel, equipment, communications, transportation, and necessary field expenses.
Once on the ground, I will coordinate as appropriate with local emergency responders, humanitarian organizations, community leaders, and other response personnel to determine where my skills, equipment, and communications capabilities can be most useful. My role and activities may change depending on the needs identified in the affected areas and the accessibility and safety of the region.
I will keep records of mission-related expenses and provide updates throughout the deployment so donors can understand how the funds are being used and what work is being carried out on the ground.
Thank you to everyone who contributes, shares this fundraiser, or supports the response in any way. Every contribution helps make it possible for me to get the equipment, communications, and resources needed to reach affected areas and assist where I can. Flood

content:
Fundraiser by Kurshat Uyghur : Support Uyghur film & tell the story together
Kurshat Uyghur is organizing this fundraiser.
We've been making preparation for this film for nearly a year. It is a story of a young Uyghur man’s life in exile after losing contact with his family members. We have received funding from a few organizations, but not quite enough for the entire production process. So we decided to ask for help from those of you who care about the Uyghurs and the work that we’re doing. Our goal is to reach $10,000.
If you have any interest in Uyghur culture or the Uyghur film industry, then please consider a contribution. Your small act of kindness will greatly enhance this film, you will not be disappointed. This film will open your eyes to stories from a beautiful and marginalized people group
The film will be released on March 21st, 2023. All donors will be listed in the end credits and receive a steamable/ download link to the film, and donors who give $100 or more contributions will receive special thanks and additional gifts as shown below:
$100 donation - you will receive a physical copy of the film and a handwritten thank you letter.
$200 donation - you will receive a physical copy of the film, a poster with the director’s signature and a handwritten thank you letter.
$500 donation - you will receive a physical copy of the film, a poster with the director’s signature and a handwritten thank you letter also your name will be present on the director's special thanks section ending of the film.
$5000 donation - you will receive all of the above and will be credited as a co-producer.
Shirzat, an Uyghur international student who has just graduated from college in the United States, had big dreams for his future prior to undertaking his education. He had planned to return to his homeland to take over his father's business, marry his long-term girlfriend, build a happy family, and become a successful entrepreneur. But with the sudden implementation of China's arbitrary mass abduction policy, millions of Uyghurs, like his father, were taken and have disappeared. For Shirzat, who wasn’t able to pursue his studies due to the crisis back home, this was tragic. He felt he had been thrown from the sky to the ground. With finances in ruins, his father missing, his family in danger, his relationship hanging by a thread, he soon spiraled into a cloud of depression and compulsive attention to politics. He withdrew from his relationships with his friends and put his life on hold while struggling to overcome his painful reality and searching for hope in the midst of it.
We will work with some of the most talented people around the world. The Director and screenwriter of this film have decades of experience in the industry. He has also made a number of short films while in university, many of which won the best picture of the year at regional and international film festivals. Our core team members are creative-minded people who have participated in numerous film projects. We have absolute confidence that we will work together as one and give the audiences astonishing results.

summary: Fundraiser by Uyghur Anthology : Support the Contemporary Uyghur Anthology This anthology funds Uyghur writers and artists, translation, events, and community growth Uyghur Anthology is organizing this fundraiser. The Contemporary Uyghur An
content:
Fundraiser by Uyghur Anthology : Support the Contemporary Uyghur Anthology
This anthology funds Uyghur writers and artists, translation, events, and community growth
Uyghur Anthology is organizing this fundraiser.
The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a publication that platforms Uyghur (and anyone drawing their roots from East Turkistan) artists and writers in the diaspora by providing a space that is often inaccessible to those in our community. There are no other projects of its kind in the English language, and with two volumes already published, we hope to take this project to the next level. It's a rare look at Uyghur expression in an environment where all our stories are told by people pushing their own narratives without the intimate knowledge of our lived experiences.
<"Manifesto" by Sumayah Jurad from Vol. II>
We asked ourselves these questions - why wait for others to invite us to the table when we can pull up a chair and introduce ourselves? Why let others speak for us without trying first to speak? Our broken English can only be improved with audacity, and world literature is only enriched by the presence of new voices.
All-in-all, our efforts have been met with support from our community and pleasant surprise from those who did not know what they did not know.
Somewhat unprecedented is that we publish the authors' original language alongside the translation. Our book is filled with Uyghur, Latin, Cyrillic, and Chinese script to encapsulate as much of our community's experience as we can.
There are many publications in diaspora communities that platform East and South Asians, SEA, MENA, and more. Central Asia is often underrepresented in world literature or Asia-specific publications, and occupied territories even less so. Uyghurs themselves have been a relatively new diaspora community in English-speaking countries, and haven't had the opportunities to grow their literary or artistic communities. Many don't have the tools to nurture their talents, or knowledge of creative networks or opportunities, even when many journals seek work from underrepresented groups. In instances where they are aware, it's difficult to be published in this competitive field without the education and styles that publications look for. There are only a handful of literary translators translating from Uyghur to English, and not many Uyghurs who have had the chances to develop their creative language when learning English.
To sum up, the issues were:
No spaces for Uyghur writers and artists to develop their skills
A disconnect from artist communities, be it local or online
No bridge between our native tongue and English, and in turn, world literature
So, we put together a small group at the Tarim Network to take on this challenge. Completely volunteer-run; the very essence of a passion project. We did a call-out for anything and all. New writers, established writers, any language, any genre, whatever we could print in a book. And here we were, the first book of its kind, created to speak for ourselves without outsider voices, without a publishing house, raw and straight from the source.
<From the launch of Vol. I at Harvard University>
"The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a collection of Uyghur reflections in diaspora. Weaving together memories of the homeland, experiences of displacement, and transitions of identities, this anthology is a creative reflection of the beauty and complexities of the Uyghur experience.
By centering Uyghur voices at the forefront, this anthology serves as a form of living memory in a pivotal moment of Uyghur history. The title Under the Mulberry Tree refers to a story from the Uyghur literary classic Ana Yurt, where youthful Nuri faces terrible injustices, separation, and turmoil; but for one moment in the Charbagh, his love for Sebihe and his own family is full, ripe, and sweet, like the mulberries from the ancient tree. In a similar way that the mulberry tree offered comforts in Nuri’s time of need, we hope this volume offers a place of reflection and celebration of Uyghur culture."
We'd partnered with a member from a Jewish organisation to run writing workshops and explain editorial processes, as we had never worked on something like this before. After that collaboration, we decided to publish a revised edition on our own. This time, we added editors' notes to the pages to explain certain terms and historical and cultural contexts - mainly for our own youth, who don't always have access to cultural education. We translated more pieces from Uyghur and Chinese. Our contributors spanned 13 countries, at all levels of experience.
Was this work sustainable? Equipped with the tools, experience, and outpouring of support from our first volume, we spent the next two years saying yes. Our first book was now in libraries, there were articles and academic papers that mentioned it, and most of all, we reaffirmed the need for this sort of work. Not only were we accepting submissions, we worked one-on-one with emerging writers and artists to edit their pieces. We also helped first-time translators have their first publications with help from more experienced translators, as well as connecting them with the original authors.
Our second volume was even better than the last. From the blurb:
"How do we respond to the unexpected, and how does it influence perceptions of ourselves or the environments in which we exist? As a diaspora population, unexpected encounters can shape and transform what it means to be Uyghur as we build a new life outside of the homeland. Encounters Under the Mulberry Tree takes on the literal, abstract, and expanded renditions of these moments. We feature contemporary and historical works, including art, poetry, and prose in five languages with contributors based in a dozen countries, from established writers like award-winning author and filmmaker Tahir Hamut Izgil, to emerging artists, writers and translators of all ages. This book is a library of vignettes that grapple with intersections and how we make sense of it all."
Five languages (Uyghur, English, Chinese, Russian, Turkish)
<Vol. II showcased at a college hosted by Rawan Mentorship>
Now we embark on our third volume. The three of us do this while maintaining full time jobs, academic careers, and other side projects. We all live in different countries and have only met in person once. But it's something that we need to do, for our community and for ourselves. Our contributors have gained so much from this experience and we want to extend this opportunity to more people. This needs to survive in order for similar initiatives to be born.
Supporting the editors - all expenses so far have been paid out-of-pocket or through book sales. We do not have any donors or sponsors (yet!).
Supporting our contributors - we cannot afford to pay any of our contributors. Despite this, we have given free copies of the book to contributors, but this is definitely leaving a dent in our pockets.
Recruiting more people - paid internships or remuneration for one-off work would help volunteers spend more time on this project in this economy.
Enhance our level of expertise - we want to improve. Workshops or courses for our editors and contributors, professional feedback, the works. Unfortunately there is no one who speaks Uyghur and who is involved in Western publishing or English literature on a professional or academic level. We would appreciate connections with professionals from any language background, or the funding to level up.
Expand our network - we'd love to promote our work at literary festivals, go to conferences, do book events, establish ourselves in the public eye, provide reader copies to reviewers, and so on. However, there is a funding barrier to overcome to be able to attend these events, organise, or pre-order books.
<Vol. I on display at the Mosquers Film Festival, 2025>
Munawwar Abdulla is an Uyghur advocate, poet, and scientist born on unceded Kaurna land (Australia) and based in Massachusetts. She co-founded The Tarim Network, runs Uyghur Collective, and collaborates on projects with Uyghur rights organisations around the world. Her writings and literary translations have been published in places such as Modern Poetry in Translation, Asymptote, the Margins, the Georgia Review, and others.
Sonya Imin is a mixed Uyghur American scholar and multi-disciplinary creative who has worked on art and film projects across the US, Europe, and Central Asia. Growing up between the borderlands of the Uyghur homeland, broader Central Asia, and the midwestern United States, interrogations of belonging, home, and displacement influence the nature of her work. Currently based in Brussels, she is working on her doctoral research on Uyghur artistic production in the diaspora.
Maidina Kadeer is a mixed Uyghur-Hui writer and editor, born in Ghulja and currently based in Montreal (Tiohtià:ke), Canada. She holds a BA in English Literature and Law and Society from Concordia University, with a focus on post- and neo-colonial literature. Her work explores Uyghur identity, history, and culture through cuisine, agriculture, and neo-colonialism. She has contributed to projects such as a poem, NinetySix, in Slavs and Tatars’ Contest of the Fruits (2021) and participates in panels and interviews on Agriculture and Food History to raise awareness about Uyghur culture.

Nurnisa Kurban for Uyghur Academic Foundation
Uyghur Cultural Preservation and Survival Through Education
The Uyghur people have been persecuted and subjected to repressive Chinese government policies in their Indigenous homeland of East Turkestan for many years. It is estimated that up to three million Uyghurs have been interned, imprisoned, and enslaved in detention centers, prisons, and forced labor facilities throughout China since 2017.
In 2021, the Uyghur Tribunal found that China was committing genocide and other crimes against humanity against Uyghurs. In 2022, the United Nations also concluded that China was committing human rights violations against Uyghurs amounting to crimes against humanity. Countries including the United States, Canada, the Netherlands, Czech Republic, United Kingdom, Lithuania, Belgium, and France have all declared a genocide in East Turkestan. Despite these declarations of genocide and related reports by various human rights organizations, atrocities against Uyghurs continue today with very limited international recognition and accountability.
During this time of ongoing genocide and cultural erasure in their Indigenous homeland, Uyghurs of the diaspora are working to preserve their culture and identity as a matter of survival. Uyghur education has been eradicated by the Chinese State, Uyghur texts are forbidden and in danger of being eliminated, and the Uyghur language itself is prohibited.
Uyghur scholars, linguists, and other specialists in the diaspora worldwide serve on the Uyghur Language and Education Committee of the Uyghur Academy to preserve the work of Uyghur intellectuals who have been persecuted and forcibly disappeared. This work has been ongoing since 2009 and is continuing to expand.
The Committee has created standards-aligned K-5 textbooks, which include classic and contemperory Uyghur literature, poetry, historical texts, and biographies for Uyghur children to learn about their own culture and identity in their native language. The Committee is seeking funding to expand and revise the existing K-5 textbooks, create teacher’s edition textbooks for educators, and design supplemental resources. They also hope to develop Middle and High School textbooks and related supplemental resources. To effectively implement these educational materials, they would also like to provide training for teachers.
Please consider supporting this urgent work of the Uyghur Academic Foundation as a matter of cultural survival for future generations of the Uyghur people.

content:
Fundraiser for Silkroad Uyghur by Sarah Elder : Help our local Uyghur restaurant!
Sarah Elder is organizing this fundraiser on behalf of Silkroad Uyghur.
In 2018, Gairatjan Rozi, a talented Uyghur chef, trained in Europe and now settled in America, opened 'Marco & Polo' in Hyattsville. The restaurant's menu features the cuisine of his homeland, in the Uyghur Autonomous Region of China, with classic Uyghur dishes including hand-pulled laghman noodles, dumplings, and lamb kebabs, complemented by more familiar Turkish and Mediterranean fare.
Within just a few years, Mr. Rozi and his restaurant has earned the love of our community. His food & restaurant has been featured in the local press and has earned a dedicated following in the Washington DC region.
Unfortunately the COVID-19 pandemic is forcing Mr. Rozi to close his family-run kitchen, shutter his beloved restaurant, and put in storage his colorful collection of Uyghur artifacts which decorate 'Marco & Polo.'
But Mr. Rozi is hopeful. Having dedicated his new life in America to 'Marco & Polo,' he dreams of reopening his restaurant soon - in a new location that will attract even more customers who want to enjoy & explore both the cuisine and the Uyghur culture of Central Asia.
Your generous donation to this GoFundMe effort will help Mr. Rozi begin to recover finically from the COVID-19 disaster and allow him to pursue his dream of creating another unique Uyghur dining experience for our community! Rehmet! (Uyghur for 'thank you')

content:
Fundraiser by Aydin Anwar : Uyghur Students in Egypt
Aydin Anwar is organizing this fundraiser.
Help save Muslim Uyghur students in Egypt from deportation to China, where they will face detention, persecution, torture, lengthy prison sentences, and perhaps even death.
Hundreds of Muslim Uyghur students in Egypt with resident permits are currently being rounded up to be deported to China, where they will be subject to persecution, imprisonment, torture, and death sentences. Their crime? Being Uyghur and studying Islam. #SaveUyghurStudents
In its attempt to "crackdown on Islamic extremism", China has significantly tightened its security measures and prohibition of religious practice in East Turkestan (aka Xinjiang, occupied by China). Chinese authorities are now seeking the return of thousands of innocent Uyghur students abroad in "wide sweeps" to extend this crackdown.
It has been reported that all airports in Egypts are preventing Uyghurs from leaving the country. Some Uyghur students have already been deported, and the remaining are either in detention awaiting deportation or in hiding within Egypt’s borders. Several that we know managed to escape to Turkey, but are currently homeless or in extreme financial hardship.
Therefore the funds we collect will go to providing shelter, food and other support to the Uyghurs who have already managed to flee Egypt. It will also go to provide those in hiding with necessities (e.g. food, room, board) while we work with nonprofit human rights organizations to pressure Egypt and China to stop the deportations and detentions.
The funds will be collected through Uyghur Youth Campaign, a 501(c) nonprofit based in the US, and will (for now) be directly delivered to the Uyghur students who fled to Turkey by one of its members, Aydin Anwar, who has been in Istanbul. She is connected with these refugees through Munevver Ozuygur, an Uyghur activist based in Zeytinburnu, Istanbul.
Please donate and help spread awareness. Do not remain silent as these young men and women are sent off to be detained, tortured, imprisoned and perhaps even killed in China. They need our help.

Mr. Xia and many other defendants can’t afford to hire a qualified and experienced attorney to defend themselves. Thus, with suggestions by many web bystanders, Xia started a campaign to collect donation for legal fees against Guo.
Xia will use those donations only for the purpose of the lawsuit and he has been supported by several volunteers to work on collection, bookkeeping and supervision of donations. The goal has been set to 100,000 US$, and an individual account of GoFundMe was set up as a major channel for donation.
Please contact Julia Lee and other volunteers through [email redacted] for the details.
We’re most grateful to your attention, encouragement, support and great help!
原北大教授、政治异议人士，现时政/财经新闻评论人夏业良先生（美国之音/自由亚洲电台/博讯/新唐人等媒体）因网络质疑和评论，而被中国逃亡商人郭文贵花钱组织围攻/抹黑，并在美国弗吉尼亚东区联邦法院提交所谓诽谤指控和滥诉。
夏先生通过电视节目和推特对郭的所谓爆料（包括最高机密信息）进行了质疑和批评，郭雇佣组织了对夏及其家人的网络围攻，同时指控夏对他进行诽谤并索赔五百万美元。
郭滥用美国司法资源， 目前正在进行中的诉讼超过41起，郭宣称他计划起诉至少91位对他进行诽谤的个人。
夏先生和其他被告均无力承担雇佣合格并有经验的律师之花费。因此在众多网络旁观者的建议下开始了募捐应对郭之诉讼的律师费用。
夏先生将把募捐得款只用于本案诉讼之中，并且得到若干志愿者的支持和帮助，他们协助收集募捐款项/记账与募捐监督等工作。本次募捐活动的目标已设定为十万美元，并且已经开设了一个名为“GoFundMe”之软件的募捐账户平台以作为主要募捐渠道。
请各位捐助者通过电子邮箱：[email redacted] 与Julia Lee等志愿者联系，以获得相关细节。

title: (无标题)
summary: Fundraiser by Heather Liu : Help A #MeToo Survivor and Daughter Win Their Case Heather Liu is organizing this fundraiser. What I’ve experienced isn’t what any woman should ever go through. First there was the violence of non-consensual sex
content:
Fundraiser by Heather Liu : Help A #MeToo Survivor and Daughter Win Their Case
Heather Liu is organizing this fundraiser.
What I’ve experienced isn’t what any woman should ever go through. First there was the violence of non-consensual sex forced on me, followed by lies and denial. Then, rare moments of hope, followed by setbacks tinged with revenge from a father whose fear of revealing truth drives him to deny his child’s existence. This child is my daughter. For 20 years I’ve hidden the nightmare involving her origin by my silence, partly due to the sense of shame and partly because the father of my child is a influential public figure. Till the rapist has pushed us to a corner by threatening our existence with vicious conspiracy theories.
（我經歷了任何一位女性都不該經歷的事情。先是遭遇性侵，接著還要面對謊言、抵賴和詆毀。過去20年來，間或閃現的希望，卻因我女兒的生父拒絕承認這孩子的存在，而淹沒在長久的幻滅中。過去20年來，我一直對女兒的身世三緘其口，讓一段揮之不去的夢魘深藏內心，一方面出於羞辱感，另一方面無法面對孩子的生父作為一個公眾人物給我心靈帶來的扭曲。）
With your help, the truth of our experience will be told. When it is, I hope justice will prevail. This is why I’m emerging from the shadows.
（因您伸出援手，我將得以說出這段真實的經歷。當真相大白的那一天到來，我希望正義能夠隨之彰顯。）
In 2000, I was a journalist working for a local Chinese newspaper in Los Angeles. I was assigned to interview a famous Chinese dissident, a political refugee in America, who people called the “Godfather of the Democratic Movement in China.” I wrote the story, but in doing so, my life was changed forever by his sexual assault of me.
（2000年，身為洛杉磯當地一家中文媒體記者的我，被派去採訪一位著名的中國異議人士，也是我本人非常敬仰的政治流亡者、一位被視為「中國民主運動之父」的風雲人物。我完成了採訪任務，然而我的個人生活卻因今生與他這唯一的遭逢而徹底脫軌。）
Let’s just say, nine months after I did that story, I gave birth to my daughter, who bore no resemblance to my then-husband. My husband knew why since I’d told him about the sexual assault after it happened. My marriage ended, and my life as a single mom began. To protect my daughter and me from possible backlash about how she was conceived and her father’s identity, I kept my ordeal quiet. The two of us moved to Hong Kong.
（在我做了那次採訪的9個月之後，我的女兒降生了。她跟我當時的丈夫長得一點也不像，而我丈夫也並不感到驚訝，因為我早跟他坦白了我遭遇性侵的事。我的婚姻其實從那時起已名存實亡，我作為一個單親母親的生涯也即將開始。為了遠離各種因孩子身世而產生的猜忌，讓我和孩子可以過安靜而屬於自己的生活，同時也為了可以就近得到父母家人的幫忙照顧，我帶著孩子離開了美國，赴香港尋找發展機會。）
Through the years I never thought about contacting my daughter's biological father, whom I met only once. I didn’t consider doing this even after I lost my job as an editor in 2012. But then a former colleague, Beifeng, left Hong Kong for the United States. He’d criticized me for "depriving the child the right to be recognized by her father," and later persuaded me to let him bring a lock of my daughter’s hair, wrapped it in tissue paper, that he took with him to the United States.
（多年來，我從未想過要聯絡孩子的生父，那個我只見過一面的人，哪怕是2012年我失業的時候也沒萌生這個打算。我根本已經忘記了這個人，要不是當時正要動身赴美的前同事北風（我告訴了他我的孩子生父是誰，但沒有讓他知道詳情，他也沒有探問）批評我「剝奪孩子認父的權利」。他太太當即揪了孩子幾根頭髮，用手紙包了起來。）
Months later, my heart sank when Beifeng reported back to me that this man had denied everything, even the possibility of knowing me, let alone the possibility of having fathered a child. He’d committed this horrible crime against me, but he refused to acknowledge this truth. For to accept that he’d fathered a daughter, he’d have to admit how she came to existence. It appeared that he was refusing to allow his carefully crafted story about his “heroic” life to be marred by acknowledging his daughter’s existence.
（幾個月之後，北風帶來消息並深表意外地說，孩子的生父得知自己可能有個孩子時的反應，竟是敷衍和閃躲，好像根本不可能有這回事一樣。他當然寧肯忘記自己做過的事，但真相怎麼能因你不想面對就可以不承認、孩子怎麼可以就這樣當她不存在呢？就像他後來在郵件裡提到的，他所關切的，是這事將來在他的回憶錄裡該怎麼寫，而不是他身為人父應該盡什麼責。他在意的只是他自己英雄般的人生，無論如何不能留下任何污點。）
After this news reached me, I was diagnosed with clinical depression and started to see a doctor regularly. Professionally, however, I had to appear calm and collected so I could earn a living that would support the two of us. I worked as a freelance writer and translator, while also raising my daughter on my own.
（我聞訊心裡沉了一下，不久開始意識恍惚，甚至試過下班下車記不起回家的方向。我遠在北京的母親聽說之後，在電話的另一頭啜泣得聲音哽咽。2013年2月，我被確診患上抑鬱症。失業更兼病倒，令我們母女的生計雪上加霜，這期間我成為自由撰稿人，還要硬撐著努力譯書維持生計。好在偶爾有父母幫手、妹妹接濟一下，才度過了一段危機。）
Five years later, in 2018, in the midst of #MeToo movement, when sexual abuse and harassment were receiving public attention globally, rumors spread online about this famous Chinese man having fathered an illegitimate child. At that point, I contacted him by phone from Hong Kong and boldly asked for child support.
（一晃又過了5年，時間到了2018年，在#MeToo（「我也是受害者」）運動的聲浪中，性侵和性騷擾現象的普遍存在引起了全球性輿論關注。在此期間，網上首次出現了對我女兒的生父「不認親」的議論。已變得反應遲緩的我這才開始應對，邁出了主動聯繫孩子生父這一步。）
He agreed to a DNA test that was performed privately in Washington D.C.., The DNA results proved that he was Charlotte's father. The person who shared the results with him said that he had responded positively to having a daughter. Accordingly, when I contacted him again, he promised to assist us by at least paying for her education. But later on, since I would not change my tone on the unhappy encounter with him in the past, he decided to deny being Charlotte’s father and began to challenge the DNA results, shirked his responsibility as her biological father, and ignored that I was a victim of his violent sexual assault.
（他於是主動提出做個DNA鑑定，並指定了一位背景相當可靠的前白宮幕僚做中間人，在華盛頓特區進行了DNA樣本的收集與鑑定。結果出來後，中間人率先通知我，說結果證明魏先生是孩子的生父無疑，並告訴我，魏先生對鑑定結果表示認可並顯得「很開心」。據此，在我與孩子的生父再次聯繫時，他表示自己起碼會負擔孩子的大學學費。但真到了時候他又變卦了，甚至仗著沒有把DNA鑑定結果如約給我們，便想將已經做過DNA鑑定這事也想賴掉。）
The rest of the story is detailed in Huaizhao Liu v. Jingsheng Wei, case #1:19-cv-03344, which was heard in the Washington, D.C. federal court. Charlotte’s father managed to find the funds necessary to hire a high-powered defense attorney to help him to deny both our dignity and his basic obligations of paternity.
（後來的事情見華盛頓特區聯邦法院卷宗（Case Number 1:19-cv-03344）。我女兒的生父大手筆聘請了專攻白領犯罪辯護的名牌大狀為自己的辯護律師，竭力搬弄法律條文進行技術性規避，想就此永遠掩蓋真相，踐踏我們母女的權益與尊嚴。）
We believe that Charlotte’s biological father should be forced to keep his promise of supporting her education, and we are asking that he release the DNA test results to us. His 19-year old daughter deserves to know the truth.
（我們堅信，法庭應該為這位竭力否認已經做過親子鑑定的生父驗明正身，然後強制他履行他的諾言，承擔他女兒的學費。我們堅信，他19歲的女兒有權利知曉真相。）
The weight of evidence is on our side, but we risk losing the lawsuit that we are filing against him if we cannot raise the money we need to hire an attorney who is as capable as his lawyer. What is at risk is Charlotte's right to a quality education, along with the legally binding acknowledgement of his paternity.
（儘管我們掌握活生生的證據，但如果籌不到聘請律師的費用，單憑我們自訴，將無法應對複雜的陪審團庭審程序。立案至今一年多來，被告採取躲和拖的戰術，先是躲傳票，然後提出「司法管轄權」爭議逼我們撤案，一計不成又援引「多國籍」條款，將案子從特區高等法院轉移到聯邦法院。）
With your assistance – with your contributions – we intend to hire an attorney who is experienced in sexual assault and paternity cases. We hope to win this #MeToo case and pursue respectful, equal and democratic human relationship in Chinese community.
（您的捐助將幫助我們聘請到專攻性侵案和親子案官司的律師，幫我們贏得這場事關尊嚴、平等、人權以及人性的人身傷害官司，並藉此推動美國的華人社區乃至全球華人的觀念進步與行為的現代化。）
Here are some online stories and commentary about this, in Chinese:
https://www.storm.mg/article/2891777?mode=whole
(by Liao Yiwu, award winner of Human Rights Watch Hellman-Hammett Grant 2003, the German Geschwister-Scholl-Preis 2011 and the Peace Prize of the German Book Trade 2012.)
（作者/廖亦武，詩人、流亡作家與底層歷史記錄者。2012年德國書業和平獎得主，並曾獲美國《當代基督教》雜誌頒發的「最佳圖書奬」、德國書業協會頒發的「紹爾兄妹獎」、德國廣播協會頒發的「最佳廣播劇奬」及德國阿夏芬堡頒發的「公民勇氣奬」。2013年，法國政府頒發給廖亦武「法蘭西文學藝術軍官獎章」。2018年，廖亦武獲美國紐約瓦茨拉夫 哈維爾圖書基金會頒發「無懼危難作家獎」。）
http://minzhuzhongguo.org/MainArtShow.aspx?AID=105641
(by Qi JIazhen, writer in exile, author of autobiographical series: Tears of the Goddess of Liberty and Red Dog. Qi is the Chairwoman of the Women Writers committee, Independent Chinese PEN Center.)
（作者/齊家貞，流亡作家，著有系列傳記《自由神的眼泪──父女两代囚徒的真實故事》（後改名《黑牆裡的倖存者》和《紅狗：—個被釋女囚的真實故事》在香港和台灣出版。齊家貞曾先後擔任國際筆會獨立中文筆會理事會理事、副會長、秘書長等職務，並在澳洲建立了“齊氏文化基金會”，每年頒發“推動中國進步獎”截至2019年已連續頒獎12屆。）
https://liuvswei.blogspot.com/2020/08/metoo.html
(by Lau Kayee, Chairwoman of Network for Women In Politics, Hong Kong; Spokeswoman of Hong Kong Civil Human Rights Front.)
（作者/劉家儀，香港婦女參政網絡主席，六四新生代秘書長，支聯會常委，香港市民捍衛人權陣線發言人。）
With your contributions, we will be able to set a positive example for #MeToo victims by raising awareness about women’s and children's rights, globally.
因您的資助，我們將能夠為#MeToo運動傷害者們建立一個積極的個案，為提高女性及孩童的權利意識而有所貢獻。

content:
Fundraiser by Kuber Poudel Chhetri : Needs for Human Right Activist
Kuber Poudel Chhetri is organizing this fundraiser.
Mr. Suk Bahadur Subba is a well known Human Rights Activist working for the politically persecuted people of the country of Bhutan. Bhutan is a country located between the boarders of India and China whose people have been persecuted for the past 25 years.
Mr. Subba is considered by the Royal Government of Bhutan to be a political dissident for fighting against the Racial Discrimination and Ethnic Cleasning of the Bhutanese People.
Mr. Subba is in desperate need of medical treatment for the transplant of both of his kidney's. We are reaching out to raise USD $ 45, 000.00 to send to India to help save the life of this man who has continually risked his own life to save the lives of hundreds of thousands of Bhutanese refugees.
http://www.bhutannewsservice.com/column-opinion/opinion/bhutanese-refugee-camps-retrospection/ You support is greatly appreciated.

content:
Fundraiser by Boston Standswithhk : US Hong Kong Safe Harbor Postcard Campaign
Boston Standswithhk is organizing this fundraiser.
***When donation, make as anonymous if you wish to hide the donator's name and make the TIPS to 0.00***
While US-China tensions continue to escalate and the November presidential elections loom near, as Hongkongers living in the United States (or any informed person in the world), we must not forget or turn a blind eye to the CCP’s continuous oppression on Hongkongers and other minority groups in China, such as Uyghurs, Tibetans, and Mongolians. With the promulgation of the new National Security Law on June 30, 2020, the government has since been arresting and charging dissidents with these vaguely-worded laws that may entail life imprisonment. In the past month alone, 12 Hong Kongers fleeing protest-related charges have been detained in China and denied meetings with lawyers since August 23, 2020; Legislative Council elections had been postponed a year in the name of “public health concerns” amidst a mass arrest of candidates; media mogul Jimmy Lai, who runs the only pro-democratic print newspaper in Hong Kong, has been arrested with the National Security Law; and the Education Bureau has begun actively censoring content they deemed politically incorrect in Liberal Studies textbooks, including concepts like “civil disobedience” and “separation of powers”, and images of Lennon Walls. Up until today, the administration has arrested more than 10,000 Hong Kongers, charged over 2,200, deployed water cannons, fired more than 16,000 tear gas canisters and over 10,000 rubber bullets against its own people. Freedom of speech, freedom of assembly and political rights as we knew it have been thoroughly eroded.
11月的美國總統大選逐漸逼近，中美關係日漸緊張，作為居住在美國的香港人或是在這個世界上任何有良知的人，面對中共對香港、維吾爾族、藏族和蒙古族的持續壓逼，我們不能容忍，更不能視而不見。自2020年6月30日頒布《國家安全法》以來，政府持續逮捕異見人​​士，並以措辭含糊的法律起訴抗爭者，香港的司法制度已經徹底淪為政府的打壓工具。及後更有12名香港抗爭者為了逃離這種不公義的審判欲流亡台灣，卻被中共非法拘捕。他們無法與律師會面，音訊全無。而香港人僅有的發聲方法——立法會選舉，卻因為「公共衛生風險」而被推遲一年；同時間，大批候選人被逮捕或是被拒絕參選。作為香港唯一異見紙媒《蘋果日報》的老闆黎智英被警方高調逮捕，《蘋果日報》總部更被大肆搜查。教育局亦積極審查通識科教科書中所謂的「政治不正確」內容，例如「公民抗命」和「三權分立」的概念，以及連儂牆相片。到今天為止，已經有超過10,000多名香港人被捕、2,200多人被起訴，警方向市民發射了超過16,000枚催淚彈和10,000多發橡皮子彈，令香港人長期生活在恐懼中。香港人的言論自由、集會自由和政治權利已被徹底侵蝕。
In light of the deteriorating situation, we plan to kickstart a new round of postcard campaign urging Congress to pass two bills related to Hong Kong as soon as possible - Hong Kong Safe Harbor Act (H.R.7415/S.4110), and Hong Kong People’s Freedom and Choice Act (H.R.7428/S.4229):
鑑於情況日益惡化，我們希望透過郵寄明信片給國會議員的方式，呼籲他們盡快通過兩項與香港有關的法案 —— 香港安全港法案 (H.R.7415 / S.4110) 和香港人民自由與選擇法(H.R.7428 / S.4229):
The Hong Kong Safe Harbor Act will designate certain Hong Kong residents who are victims of persecution or who have a well-founded fear of future persecution because of their peaceful political activities as Priority 2 refugees (excluded from refugee cap), allowing them and their spouses, children, parents to apply to the U.S. Refugee Admissions Program for protection. (Click here for more details)
《香港安全港法案》將指定某些遭受迫害，或因其參與和平的政治活動而感到恐懼的香港居民列為「優先級別2」的難民，且不受每年限額限制，亦允許他們及其配偶、子女、父母向「美國難民接納計劃」申請庇護。(詳情請瀏覽)
The Hong Kong People's Freedom and Choice Act will provide Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Hong Kongers, maintain Hong Kong’s status as autonomous for the purposes of immigration, provide special and expedited status for certain high-skilled Hong Kongers as well as expedite Permanent Resident status for Hong Kongers residing in the US. (Click here for more details)
《香港人民自由與選擇法》會為香港人提供臨時保護身份（TPS），維持香港在移民方面的自治地位，亦為部分香港專業人仕提供特殊和快速的身份，並加快辦理香港人的美國永久居民(綠卡)身份的程序。(詳情請瀏覽)
In our last postcard campaign pushing for the Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act, we delivered over 3000 postcards to Congress. We aren’t part of any formal organization and do not have operation funds. We desperately call for your contribution again to help us deliver these postcards to Congress, to remind them of Hong Kong’s urgent situation and urge them to take immediate action. Your contribution would support our printing and delivery costs. Thank you so much!
在上一次推動《香港人權與民主法》的明信片運動中，我們向國會送出了超過3000張的明信片。我們不是任何正式組織的成員，也沒有運營資金，所以我們竭誠呼籲您為我們提供資金，並幫助我們將這些明信片送交您們所屬的國會議員，提醒他們香港的緊急狀況，並呼籲他們立即採取行動。所有受到的捐款將支持我們的打印和交付成本。萬分感謝！

title: A Former Pakistani Army Captain Now Commands the BLA

11 月 14 日，拉赫曼·古尔（Rahman Gul），又名乌斯塔德·穆里德（Ustad Mureed），被任命为俾路支解放军（BLA）的领导人。古尔有着独特的背景：在巴基斯坦军队服役八年后，他离开并加入了俾路支叛乱组织。詹姆斯敦基金会报告说，他在瓦济里斯坦以及控制线进行了战斗。古尔在控制 BLA 之前是 BLA 自杀式袭击部队马吉德旅的指挥官。
巴基斯坦和中国都对俾路支叛乱表示日益担忧，双方都将其视为恐怖主义。现在，叛乱分子拥有一名由巴基斯坦军队训练和培养的指挥官。他很可能会实施一种对巴基斯坦和中国都危险的领导风格和军事战略。
古尔对军事战略有新的想法。 2026年1月至2月，BLA实施了大规模攻势，称为“赫罗夫2号行动”。这次攻势持续了六天，导致BLA伤亡惨重。他的任命被解读为对赫罗夫 2 号行动的判断。巴基斯坦冲突研究与安全研究所 (PICSS) 评估称，“赫罗夫 2 号行动的战术原则和异常沉重的成本”是导致 BLA 前领导人巴希尔·泽布下台的原因。
PICSS 援引 BLA 内部人士的话说，古尔更喜欢小型且机动的团队，而不是大型且不灵活的部队。古尔认为，大型部队会吸引国家军队的集中，并增加 BLA 的损失风险。
古尔的干部可能会保持指挥纪律和战略耐心。预计古尔将集中精力维持一​​支训练有素的核心干部队伍。古尔也是一位布拉灰诗人，他比前指挥官巴希尔·泽布更吸引俾路支青年。通过正确的规划和纪律，BLA 能够实施更有针对性的攻击。
古尔领导下的解放军不太可能发动大规模袭击。然而，由于古尔在巴基斯坦军队的经验、其他高级指挥官对军事战术的了解，以及 BLA 的重点是自杀式袭击，小型、高机动性的 BLA 小组所构成的威胁无法轻易应对。此外，小型攻击单元更难被击败，而 BLA 可以快速替换小型行动中失踪的指挥官。
2026 年暴力事件的增加进一步加剧了人们对古尔领导层的担忧。2026 年第二季度和第三季度之间，俾路支省与暴力相关的死亡人数几乎增加了两倍，第三季度有 829 人死亡。与很快失去动力的Herof 2不同，目前的BLA策略有组织且有足够的耐心来进行长时间的攻击。

On November 14, Rahman Gul, also known as Ustad Mureed, was appointed the head of the Baloch Liberation Army (BLA). Gul has a unique background: after spending eight years in the Pakistan Army, he left and joined the Baloch insurgency. The Jamestown Foundation reported that he fought in Waziristan as well as on the Line of Control. Gul was the commander of the Majeed Brigade, the BLA’s suicide attack unit, prior to assuming control of the BLA itself.
Pakistan and China have both expressed growing concern regarding the Baloch insurgency, which both regard as terrorism. Now, the insurgency has a commander that was trained and developed by the Pakistan army. He will most likely implement a style of leadership and military strategy that will be dangerous for both Pakistan and China.
Gul has new ideas regarding military strategy. In January-February 2026, the BLA implemented a large-scale offensive, known as Operation Herof 2. The offensive lasted six days, and resulted in a heavy death toll for the BLA. His appointment is interpreted as a judgment on Herof 2. The Pakistan Institute for Conflict Studies and Security (PICSS) evaluated that the “the tactical doctrine and exceptionally heavy costs of Operation Herof 2” were what led to the ouster of previous BLA leader Bashir Zeb.
PICSS, citing insiders in the BLA, reported that Gul favors small and mobile teams over large and inflexible units. Gul believes that large units draw the concentration of a country’s military and increase the risk of loss for the BLA.
Gul’s cadres are likely to maintain command discipline and strategic patience. It is expected that Gul will focus on maintaining a core of trained cadres. Gul, who is also a Brahui poet, attracts more Baloch youth than former commander Bashir Zeb. With the right planning and discipline, the BLA is capable of carrying out more targeted attacks.
The BLA under Gul is unlikely to carry out mass attacks. However, due to Gul’s experience in the Pakistani military, other senior commanders’ knowledge of military tactics, and the BLA’s focus on suicide attacks, the threat posed by small, highly mobile BLA cells cannot be countered easily. Additionally, small attack cells are more difficult to defeat, and the BLA can quickly replace lost commanders in small operations.
The concern with Gul’s leadership is further compounded by the increase in violence in 2026. Between the second and third quarters of 2026, the number of violence-related deaths in Balochistan almost tripled, with 829 deaths in the third quarter. Unlike Herof 2, which quickly lost momentum, the current BLA strategy is organized and patient enough to attack for long periods of time.
China will be alarmed as well, because Gul is believed to be the mastermind behind the increased targeting of Chinese nationals by the BLA in recent years. Between 2021 and 2024, at least 20 Chinese nationals, including employees of Beijing-funded projects, were killed in different terror attacks in Pakistan.
In 2022, three Chinese nationals, lecturers working at Karachi University, were killed in a bomb blast. The next year, in another attack, BLA terrorists killed several Chinese engineers working in a highway project near Karachi. According to PICSS, Gul is believed to have planned both attacks.
“Rahman Gul’s public messaging has long placed China at the centre of the BLA’s strategic target set,” PICSS noted. Under Gul’s leadership, then, the BLA will likely focus on carrying out more such attacks on Chinese personnel and projects in the years to come.
The Chinese government has been quite tough on Pakistan, pressuring Islamabad to take sufficient measures to counter BLA attacks. After the terror attack on the Karachi airport in 2022, in which several Chinese nationals were killed, China demanded that Pakistan secure its nationals. In early 2026, Pakistan established a new protection unit for Chinese nationals to further secure Chinese personnel working on government-funded projects in Pakistan.
Pakistan convinced Washington to name the BLA in its joint statement with the United States during the Pakistan-U.S. Counter Terrorism Dialogue in 2025. Just before that, the U.S. designated both the BLA and the Majeed Brigade as Foreign Terrorist Organizations (FTO), a longstanding request of Pakistan’s.
Funds are key to Gul’s leadership and continued BLA operations. The U.S. State Department’s FTO designation permits interagency cooperation to trace and seize terrorist financing. A joint effort to manage cyberspace and media can lessen the impact of BLA attacks and thwart further recruitment. Closed intelligence channels with Islamabad can tighten the net on Gul and other BLA leaders. The support of the U.S. may help Pakistan gain actionable intelligence to protect national interests, especially if Gul is listed as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist (SDGT).
Pakistan looks toward both China and the United States to counter the threat of the BLA in Balochistan. U.S. and Chinese investment in Balochistan (the Reko Diq and Saindak gold mines, respectively) may be a reason for both to extend help. Before entering Balochistan with its own investment, the U.S. was more concerned about Chinese investment in Pakistan via CPEC, and had reason to support Baloch nationalists who contested CPEC. Now Pakistan can seek counterterror assistance from both China and the United States to neutralize common threats.
However, only an amicable political process to alleviate the rights and representation concerns of the Baloch people will help pacify grievances and finally resolve the insurgency. The war against terrorism in Balochistan is likely to continue for a long period.

title: 专访藏人行政中央司政边巴次仁：中藏政治对话难有突破，达赖喇嘛转世问题成焦点
summary: 藏人行政中央司政边巴次仁(Penpa Tsering)2026年11月11日于美国之音华盛顿演播室接受专访。 藏人行政中央(Central Tibetan Administration)司政边巴次仁(Penpa Tsering)近日接受美国之音专访时表示，尽管藏人行政中央与中国方面仍维持非正式接触，但双方恢复实质性政治对话的前景并不乐观。 在正式对话中断多年、双方在西藏政治地位及达赖喇嘛转世问题上的分歧持续扩大的背景下，他认为，目前中国的政治环境并未为解决西藏问题创造有利条件
content:
藏人行政中央司政边巴次仁(Penpa Tsering)2026年11月11日于美国之音华盛顿演播室接受专访。
藏人行政中央(Central Tibetan Administration)司政边巴次仁(Penpa Tsering)近日接受美国之音专访时表示，尽管藏人行政中央与中国方面仍维持非正式接触，但双方恢复实质性政治对话的前景并不乐观。
在正式对话中断多年、双方在西藏政治地位及达赖喇嘛转世问题上的分歧持续扩大的背景下，他认为，目前中国的政治环境并未为解决西藏问题创造有利条件。与此同时，他警告，中国近年来的民族政策和教育安排可能进一步削弱藏语及藏族文化的代际传承。
面对政治谈判前景的不确定性，边巴次仁表示，藏人行政中央未来五年除了继续寻求通过谈判解决中藏争端，也将着重强化自身行政体系，维持流亡藏人社群的长期延续，并争取美国等国际社会的支持。
谈及与中国方面的沟通渠道，边巴次仁表示，双方目前仍维持一些非正式接触，而且这些接触最初是由中方发起的。只要中方没有停止，他认为藏人行政中央也没有理由中断。
“我一直认为这些接触并不能产生实质效果。这更像是让中方了解藏人行政中央在做什么，尤其是达赖喇嘛的情况，”他说。
边巴次仁说，虽然外界普遍认为这些非正式渠道未来可能发挥作用，但他本人并不对此抱有很大期待。
北京与藏人政府的正式接触此前已经中断多年。此前，北京政府和达赖喇嘛代表在2002年到2010年之间进行了九轮对话，但是没有产生任何具体成果。自此双方的正式沟通渠道暂停至今。
边巴次仁认为，目前中国的政治环境并没有为政治对话留下太多空间。他说，无论从中国整体情况，还是西藏和蒙古等地区的情况来看，在现行领导层之下，都很难看到展开政治对话的空间。他希望未来中国出现更愿意进行理性沟通的领导层，或者现任领导层改变目前的立场。
中国政府一直将西藏问题界定为涉及国家主权和领土完整的内部事务，拒绝接受藏人行政中央作为一个政治实体参与谈判。
北京过去曾表示，愿意与达赖喇嘛的私人代表接触，但要求对方放弃独立主张。中国外交部2024年4月曾表示，中方只愿与达赖喇嘛的私人代表进行接触和商谈，不接受藏人行政中央参与相关接触。
藏人行政中央长期主张通过“中间道路”寻求解决方案，即不要求西藏脱离中国，而是在中华人民共和国框架内实现真正的自治。不过，北京方面一直没有接受这一政治主张。
除了政治对话问题，边巴次仁还谈到了达赖喇嘛未来的转世安排。
边巴次仁批评中国政府一方面对西藏宗教活动实施严格管理，另一方面又希望介入达赖喇嘛的转世认定。他认为，北京希望掌握下一世达赖喇嘛的认定权，是因为这一问题具有重要的政治影响力。
“他们控制西藏的宗教活动，却又希望介入转世问题，因为他们知道这在政治上非常重要。他们认为，如果能够控制下一世达赖喇嘛的转世，就能够控制整个西藏。”他说。
中国外交部表示，藏传佛教活佛转世有金瓶掣签等程序，达赖喇嘛转世也必须遵循相关传统，最终须经中央政府批准。北京认为，中央政府对达赖喇嘛转世认定具有最终批准权。
2025年7月，达赖喇嘛在其90岁生日之前发表声明，确认达赖喇嘛这一宗教制度将继续延续，并表示未来转世认定的责任属于达赖喇嘛办公室所属的甘丹颇章基金会(Gaden Phodrang Trust)。中国政府则重申，达赖喇嘛转世必须在中国境内寻访，并按照宗教仪轨、历史定制和国家法律规定办理。
除了宗教和政治问题，边巴次仁也对中国近年来在西藏实施的民族政策和教育政策表达担忧，尤其关注藏语教育和年轻一代的文化传承。
他特别提到中国的《民族团结进步促进法》，认为这项法律可能进一步压缩藏人维护自身语言和文化传统的空间。这部法律于2023年启动立法工作，2026年3月经全国人大通过，并于同年7月正式施行。其核心目标是将“铸牢中华民族共同体意识”和“推进中华民族共同体建设”纳入国家法律制度。
联合国人权专家就此事专门致函中国政府，对该法可能侵犯少数民族语言、文化、宗教及其他人权提出担忧，认为统一化的民族政策可能给少数民族社群的文化权利带来风险。
边巴次仁认为中国政府的最终目标是同化藏人。他说，西藏一些年仅四岁的儿童已经被送入以普通话为主要教学语言的寄宿学校。
“当我们的孩子回家来，他们不愿意再说藏语，这对我们来说是最可怕的事情。这简直等同于文化层面的种族灭绝，”他告诉美国之音。
中国政府则表示，民族团结和国家通用语言文字教育有助于促进不同民族之间的交流、教育公平和经济社会发展。中国官方说，藏语和其他少数民族语言文字依法受到保护，寄宿学校是根据部分地区地理条件和教育资源分布设立的教育安排，并非强迫同化。
美国之音此前也曾就西藏寄宿学校问题进行报道，讨论相关教育政策对藏族儿童语言和文化传承可能产生的影响。
美国之音就边巴次仁此次提出的相关说法致函中国大使馆和美国国务院寻求评论，截至发稿前没有收到回复。
谈到美国，边巴次仁表示，藏人行政中央与美国政府保持着良好关系。
“美国是唯一一个制定专门涉藏法律的政府，我们与美国政府的关系非常强健，”他告诉美国之音。
今年8月，美国两党联邦参议员推出法案，强化对藏人的支持。
参议院外交委员会主席、爱达荷州共和党联邦参议员吉姆·里施(Jim Risch)联袂俄勒冈州民主党联邦参议员杰夫·默克利(Jeff Merkley)牵头推出了《确保西藏未来法》(Assuring the Future of Tibet Act)。
参议员们说，这部法案将加强美国与民选的藏人流亡政府--藏人行政中央的接触，“并确保美国对西藏的持久支持超越第十四世达赖喇嘛尊者的有生之年。”
此外，美国在2002年通过《西藏政策法》(Tibetan Policy Act of 2002)，2020年通过《西藏政策与支持法》（Tibetan Policy and Support Act of 2020），2024年又通过了《促进解决西藏与中国争端法》(Promoting a Resolution to the Tibet-China Dispute Act (Resolve Tibet Act) of 2024)，进一步强化了美国有关推动藏人与北京对话、维护西藏文化和宗教身份的政策立场。
美国前总统拜登在2024年7月签署该法案时表示，美国将继续呼吁中国与达赖喇嘛或其代表在没有先决条件的情况下恢复直接对话，以寻求通过谈判解决分歧。
中国政府则批评美国相关立法干涉中国内政，认为华盛顿利用西藏问题向中国施压。

title: 间谍丑闻、贸易失衡：习近平的APEC“高光”会否蒙尘？
source: 纽约时报中文网 国际纵览

content:
中国领导人习近平周二在中国深圳出席一场会议。通过在这个科技中心主办亚太经合组织峰会，习近平可能希望借此证明中国的增长可以惠及世界。 Pool photo by Maxim Shemetov
1992年时任中国最高领导人邓小平视察深圳时，他利用这座中国南方城市释放了拥抱开放市场的信号，开启了数十年的快速增长，最终使他的国家成为了世界工厂。
自那时起，深圳从一个偏僻小镇发展成为闪耀的大都市，甚至令早已声名显赫的邻居香港相形见绌。苹果的主要组装商富士康在这里运营着一个庞大的园区，沃尔玛在此管理其中国业务。它也是华为、比亚迪和无人机制造商大疆等众多中国品牌的总部所在地。
本周，中国领导人习近平在这座城市主办一场区域经济峰会，以此来证明中国的增长可以惠及世界。深圳已为此场合进行了精心布置，公交候车亭贴满了标语：“建设亚太共同体，促进共同繁荣。”
但对于中国的许多贸易伙伴来说，其中一些信息可能难以接受。对他们而言，深圳也同样体现了当今世界对中国感到不安的诸多因素：廉价出口商品的泛滥、构成安全风险的科技巨头，以及一个用更多的国家控制取代了邓小平的自由试验的共产党。
习近平在亚太经合组织论坛上备受瞩目的时刻也将因美国芯片巨头英伟达的中国间谍丑闻指控蒙上阴影，该指控已经促使华盛顿收紧中国获取先进美国芯片的渠道。
他将首次与特朗普总统和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京举行会晤，这次聚会可能会让乌克兰等小国感到不安。（特朗普也曾暗示，他在中国期间可能会与朝鲜独裁者金正恩见面。）
从某种意义上说，选择深圳作为举办地本身就可以被解读为一种反抗的声明。
深圳是华为、中兴等被华盛顿贴上国家安全风险标签的公司的总部，也是许多中国人工智能实验室的所在地，这些实验室正竞相缩小与美国竞争对手的差距。许多公司都受到了美国的制裁并被列入黑名单。
研究中国领导层政治的克莱蒙特·麦肯纳学院教授裴敏欣表示，习近平希望表明，尽管美国竭尽全力通过这些贸易限制手段进行打压，但“中国依然可以发展得很好”。
深圳的一家华为门店。这家公司已被美国政府贴上国家安全风险的标签。 Cheng Xin/Getty Images
自华盛顿于2022年开始限制向中国直接销售先进芯片以来，北京一直试图树立这种形象，将华为的国产处理器以及DeepSeek等中国实验室的突破性人工智能模型作为美国限制措施没有见效的证明。
北京还将自己塑造成其他国家在技术进步方面的合作伙伴，提供中国在人工智能方面的合作和专业知识，抗衡美国试图团结合作伙伴、建立不依赖中国的人工智能供应链的策略。
对中国而言，近期的新闻可能会转移人们对即将召开的峰会的注意力。在距离会议还不到三周的时候，《纽约时报》报道称，一名与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋关系密切的中国女商人被发现向北京传递情报。此后的几天里，黄仁勋已经辞职，公司董事会表示将展开调查。
这些被中国否认的指控原本可能会破坏与特朗普的会谈，并危及两国脆弱的贸易休战。对于一个要在重要活动中接待商界和政府领导人的国家来说，如此直白的间谍阴谋指控可能也会引起尴尬。
3月，英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋。《纽约时报》报道称，一名与黄仁勋关系密切的中国女商人被发现向北京传递情报。 Manuel Orbegozo for The New York Times
中国在继续推进议程，仿佛什么都没有发生。在某种程度上，北京已经取得了一场胜利：这一争议未能破坏习近平与特朗普之间的预定会谈，特朗普已经淡化了被指存在的间谍阴谋。
特朗普并未宣布他将就英伟达丑闻与中国对抗，而是表示他不打算提及此事。周一，当在白宫外被问及其政府内部在对华强硬程度上的分歧时，他告诉记者：“我认为你不应该在去中国之前去得罪它。”
但这项丑闻已经让中国付出了代价。周一，特朗普政府发布了一项规定，阻止中国公司通过第三国的数据中心获取先进的英伟达芯片，并要求向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、印度尼西亚和巴西的公司出口芯片必须获得许可。
中国的出口机器几乎不可战胜。中国本月报告称，今年前10个月贸易顺差超过1万亿美元，有望打破去年的纪录。
但随着中国工厂大量生产太阳能电池板、电动汽车和其他面向全球消费者的商品，中国不仅面临来自美国的抵制，还面临来自世界各地的抵制。它需要阻止欧盟等贸易伙伴阻碍其出口的努力。
这就是为什么中国将此次活动宣传为该地区倡导自由贸易和反对保护主义的一个机会。
去年，中国合肥一家汽车工厂生产线上工作的员工。北京一直力推国产品牌、挤压外资品牌市场。 Florence Lo/Reuters
实际上，中国一直在转向内向型发展。北京试图挤压外国技术、电子产品和汽车品牌的市场，扶持中国企业。在习近平领导下加强了对经济控制的共产党上个月誓言要扩大其在互联网公司内部的影响力。前中国外交部政策规划官员沈伟中称这种做法是“可管控的开放”，其中安全与增长同等重要。
习近平意在将世界对中国商品的依赖转化为筹码，这也疏远了其他国家。
北京去年对稀土出口实施了管制，最近又采取行动限制数十项技术的出口，包括无人机、人工智能模型和智能体，以及有关先进药物和太阳能电池板的专业知识。中国表示，这些措施是对美国黑名单和出口限制的回应。
“中国领导人认识到，全球化的黄金时代已经结束，地缘经济竞争已成为新常态，”约翰斯·霍普金斯大学政治经济学教授洪源远表示。
预计习近平将于周四与特朗普和普京举行会谈，这是一次史无前例的会议。中国外交部周一称这次会议“具有开创性意义”。
对北京来说，这次聚会将中国塑造成一个能够让华盛顿和莫斯科坐到同一张谈判桌前的权力中间人。克莱蒙特·麦肯纳学院的裴敏欣表示，习近平希望向世界、特别是向本国人民展示，在他领导下的中国是“举足轻重、有影响力且备受尊重的，拥有巨大的号召力”。
5月，习近平与俄罗斯总统普京在北京。预计这两位领导人将在深圳与特朗普举行会谈，这将是一次史无前例的会议。 Maxim Shemetov/Reuters
特朗普周一表示，他计划在深圳讨论乌克兰战争。上海国际问题研究院高级研究员赵隆表示，北京不愿在和平谈判中牵头，以免造成“大国正在瓜分其他国家利益”的“错误印象”。
特朗普还提出了另一位客人的可能性：朝鲜独裁者金正恩。他周一离开白宫时告诉记者：“我们可能还会见金正恩。所以，那会很好。我们可以——我们有机会取得很多成就。”
中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆周二在被问及金正恩是否会出席时表示：“我们没有这方面的信息。”俄罗斯国家通讯社援引克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·S·佩斯科夫的话报道称，如果这位朝鲜领导人前往中国，普京可能会与他会面。

title: 间谍指控、安全担忧：中美围绕人工智能的紧张局势加剧
source: 纽约时报中文网 国际纵览

content:
黄安伟, DUSTIN VOLZ2026年11月18日
对间谍活动的怀疑加剧了华盛顿与北京在人工智能问题上的相互猜疑。 Haiyun Jiang/The New York Times
今年秋季早些时候，特朗普总统与中国领导人习近平会晤时，双方似乎都致力于在如何规范先进人工智能的快速发展方面寻求共识。
“中美两国都是人工智能大国，有能力也有责任发展好、管控好人工智能，确保人工智能发展始终受控于人、造福于民，”习近平9月在白宫宏伟的门厅里说。
特朗普呼应了这种精神，他说：“我们今天在这些领域做出的决定，可以促进未来几十年的和平与繁荣。”但他曾称对人工智能威胁的担忧是“骗局”，并在那周早些时候在联合国表示，他将把人工智能称为“超级智能”，给它一个更好的品牌形象。
现任和前任美国官员表示，在今年第三次领导人峰会前夕，尽管人们对这项技术的担忧与日俱增，但两人及其政府在谈判人工智能安全问题和发展指导方针方面，几乎没有取得任何进展。
而这还是在黄仁勋上周被迫辞去英伟达首席执行官一职之前发生的事情，英伟达供应的计算机芯片正是推动人工智能热潮的动力。
《纽约时报》上月报道称，美国收集的情报显示，一名与黄仁勋关系密切的新加坡中国女商人可能一直在秘密为中国主要间谍机构工作或与其有联系，随后黄仁勋辞职。黄仁勋已公开承认他有婚外情。
今年5月，黄仁勋在北京人民大会堂出席中国国务院总理李强与美国商界代表的会晤，并向媒体发表讲话。 Pool photo by Go Nakamura
近年来，技术的进步——尤其是人工智能的进步——已成为这两个超级大国经济和军事竞争的焦点，但这些问题从未像现在这样备受瞩目。
“我们之间的主要竞争点肯定在人工智能、量子计算、生物技术、网络等所有这些问题上，”曾在美国拜登政府担任驻华大使的前职业外交官R·尼古拉斯·伯恩斯说。
“但显然，我们有自身的利益考量，我认为他们也是如此，”他还说。“我们要确保竞争不会偏离正轨，以免造成不稳定，并可能增加冲突爆发的概率。”
国务卿鲁比奥上周表示，两国政府已经在“某种程度上在技术层面”就人工智能安全进行了对话。“显然，我们听取了他们的观点，他们也听取了我们的观点，但这仍是一项正在进行中的工作，”他说。
现任和前任美国官员表示，进展乏力的原因之一是，两国对人工智能带来的最大风险有着不同的看法。
在美国，官员、高管和研究人员谈论的是人工智能可能实现自主化、在不受人类控制的情况下自行工作，甚至统治人类的可能性。
这在中国也是一个令人担忧的问题，但中国政府似乎更担心人工智能会被人利用来动摇中国共产党。
据《纽约时报》报道，与此同时，中共的主要间谍和反情报机构国家安全部，旨在利用人工智能在国内和海外收集情报。
关于间谍活动的怀疑加剧了华盛顿和北京在人工智能问题上的互不信任。官员们说，双方都认为对方在从事间谍活动，以了解更多关于竞争对手人工智能机密的信息，并更快地主导技术发展。
涉及黄仁勋和英伟达扑朔迷离的交易与间谍丑闻给特朗普和习近平的会晤蒙上了阴影，峰会定于周四在中国南方科技和制造业中心深圳举行。
在第二任期内，特朗普已下令美国政府放宽对中国先进芯片的出口限制。但在周一，特朗普政府宣布正在推进一项新规定，该规定将限制中国通过利用其他国家的数据中心获取某些芯片的能力。
去年在华盛顿会议中心举办的一场由英伟达参与的展览活动中，与会者参观展出的计算技术。 Eric Lee for The New York Times
关于先进芯片的政策与人工智能发展的安全问题是分开推进的。目前由财政部主导着关于安全问题的初步对话。批评人士表示，这些谈判实际上并不存在，尽管财政部长斯科特·贝森特坚称它们将会进行。
他上周表示，两国政府“期望就发布前评估和测试先进模型的最佳实践，以及让这项技术牢牢受控于人类判断的最佳实践进行交流”。
他还说，双方正在“建立一个直接渠道，以确保任何一国都能及时向另一国通报”涉及人工智能模型的“严重事件”。
正如他与特朗普最终所做的那样，习近平同意与拜登政府就人工智能展开对话。首次会议于2024年5月在日内瓦举行。拜登的助手曾希望中国派出最密切参与监控或监管人工智能发展的三个机构的官员，其中包括间谍机构国家安全部。
但前美国官员说，中国派出的是外交部官员，这让美方感到失望。双方几乎没有取得任何进展。
然而，在同年11月，当拜登和习近平在秘鲁利马举行最后一次会晤时，两位领导人宣布了一项关于人工智能的协议——两国核武库必须由人类而不是人工智能来控制。
但与特朗普一样，一些中国官员对任何可能限制更广泛发展的举措都持警惕态度。
一方面，中国政府认为这项技术对于应对即将到来的人口危机至关重要。人工智能可以推动一波机器人劳动力浪潮。
“中国人将我们进行的任何类型的接触，都视为一种为了真正压制他们，或不让他们的产业尽可能快速发展的策略，”前国家安全局兼美国网络司令部负责人、退役将军保罗·中曾根上个月在一次台上采访中表示。
一名美国高级情报官员表示，即使中国承诺遵守一项关于人工智能安全的国际协议，考虑到其过去违反网络安全协议的历史，美国官员也很可能会怀疑北京是否会遵守这些条款。
2015年，北京与奥巴马政府签署了一项协议，承诺两国不会为了窃取知识产权而入侵对方的公司。但这名官员说，美国情报机构很快得出结论，认为中国违反了该协议——后来华盛顿公开指责了北京的这一行为。
中共官员似乎认为，人工智能虽然带来了新的风险，但可用于监控中国公民，并加强党的控制。政府的互联网监管机构中国国家互联网信息办公室同时也是人工智能的监督者。本世纪初，该机构压制了相对自由的中国互联网，并将网络空间转变为安全官员进行监视的受控区域。
另一方面，主要间谍机构负责人陈一新在9月的一篇文章中清楚地表达了政府对人工智能可能威胁党的统治的焦虑。他呼吁加强党对人工智能的控制，以防止政治动荡，防御来自“敌对势力”的网络攻击和虚假信息运动，并在军事上与美国竞争。
美国官员表示，陈一新的间谍机构参与了一系列涉及人工智能的活动，包括可能收集有关黄仁勋和其他美国科技高管的情报。
中国政府表示，对曾在新加坡科技公司Megaspeed工作的中国高管黄乐(Alice Huang)的间谍担忧纯属“捕风捉影”。
有迹象表明，中国已动用黑客手段，以寻求更深入地了解美国在人工智能方面的战略。
上个月，总部位于美国的网络安全公司Proofpoint发布了调查结果，指责与中国有关联的黑客组织将目标瞄准了美国研究机构、大学和律师事务所的人工智能专家。其中一些人从事监管和出口工作。
该活动依赖于电子邮件，黑客在邮件中冒充人工智能政策制定者，包括白宫的一名高级政策制定者。
Proofpoint没有透露黑客的企图是否成功，但表示，在“中美在人工智能、出口管制和战略技术方面的竞争日益激烈之际，这一活动符合中国更广泛的情报优先事项”。

title: 英伟达丑闻加深特朗普政府内部裂痕
source: 纽约时报中文网 国际纵览
summary: JONATHAN SWAN, MAGGIE HABERMAN, ANA SWANSON, SHAWN McCREESH2026年11月18日 特朗普总统周一承认，财政部长贝森特与商务部长卢特尼克一直存在分歧，争论的焦点是应该采取多严厉的措施堵住中国通过其他国家的数据中心获取先进人工智能芯片的漏洞。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times 特朗普总统周一启程前往亚洲，准备与中国国家主席习近平举行会晤。与此同时，特朗普政府内部对于如何在人工智能技术领域向
content:
JONATHAN SWAN, MAGGIE HABERMAN, ANA SWANSON, SHAWN McCREESH2026年11月18日
特朗普总统周一承认，财政部长贝森特与商务部长卢特尼克一直存在分歧，争论的焦点是应该采取多严厉的措施堵住中国通过其他国家的数据中心获取先进人工智能芯片的漏洞。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times
特朗普总统周一启程前往亚洲，准备与中国国家主席习近平举行会晤。与此同时，特朗普政府内部对于如何在人工智能技术领域向中国施压存在公开分歧。
特朗普在出发前表示，他不想采取“冒犯中国”的举动。
特朗普内阁内部对华政策之争公开化表明，英伟达丑闻的余波进一步加深了政府内部的裂痕，也使美国应该如何应对北京的争论浮出水面。
特朗普定于本周在中国科技中心深圳举行的峰会上与习近平和俄罗斯总统普京会晤。他既要应对美国头号竞争对手带来的国家安全挑战，又希望扶持英伟达的芯片业务，并避免与中国再次爆发贸易战，在这些目标之间，他一直难以取得平衡。
周一，这些矛盾成为关注焦点。特朗普承认，财政部长贝森特与商务部长卢特尼克一直存在分歧，争论的焦点是应该采取多严厉的措施，堵住中国通过其他国家的数据中心获取先进人工智能芯片的漏洞。
“一个想对中国友好，另一个则想跟中国大干一场，”特朗普在启程前往亚洲之前，在白宫南草坪对记者谈到这两位内阁部长时说。“两种想法都可以接受，只是观点不同。”
上周，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在两段婚外情曝光后辞职，使这场争论进一步激化。其中一段婚外情的对象是黄乐(Alice Huang)，美国官员认定她是中国情报机构的一名线人。
马来西亚一处正在建设中的数据中心园区，摄于上个月。 Ulet Ifansasti for The New York Times
在这场风波中，特朗普在公开场合似乎更担心冒犯习近平，而不是国家安全面临的风险。他一直试图淡化有关美国情报官员以及国务卿鲁比奥曾亲自就黄仁勋的婚外情及中国间谍活动向他发出警告的报道。
中国官员否认黄乐是情报人员。周一，特朗普再次对她的间谍身份表示怀疑。
“我不知道她是不是间谍，”他对记者说。“一般说来，只要有漂亮的中国女人来到这个国家，他们就会说她是间谍。”
一名记者指出，鲁比奥曾警告特朗普，黄乐是一名间谍。“谁告诉我的？”特朗普问道。
当被问及总统在如何对待中国的争论中持何立场时，白宫发言人马修·米德尔顿大力宣扬特朗普政府周一出台的新规。这项规定旨在堵住中国通过第三国获取美国先进芯片的漏洞。
“这一行动将有助于确保美国最先进的芯片首先流向美国的超级智能创新企业，而不是中国的空壳公司，”米德尔顿在一份声明中说，他使用了特朗普偏爱的“超级智能”说法。
“特朗普政府将继续采取果断行动，保护美国的技术优势，加强我们的国家安全，并确保超级智能的未来在美国构建，”米德尔顿补充说。
据六名以上直接了解相关讨论的现任和前任官员称，特朗普政府内部在对华政策上的分歧并不限于这两位争执不下的内阁部长。争论一方是卢特尼克，他的部门负责制定和执行芯片出口规定，他推动对数据中心采取更宽松的限制措施。另一方是贝森特、特朗普的国家安全顾问鲁比奥、美国贸易代表格里尔，以及国家安全委员会的大部分人。几个月来，他们一直主张全面限制中国获取人工智能芯片。
据顾问们透露，特朗普私下里在两派之间摇摆不定，立场时常变化。
在周五的一次电视采访中，贝森特批评商务部未能对处于英伟达丑闻中心的新加坡公司Megaspeed实施制裁，称商务部“掌握着决定权”。他还表示，如果英伟达没有采取足够措施阻止芯片被非法转运至中国，就应该被“追究责任”。
从正式的政策决定来看，特朗普站在了财长一边。就在启程前往亚洲不久前，特朗普政府出台了限制中国获取芯片的新规。这是贝森特一直推动、卢特尼克则始终反对的措施。
但总统周一摇摆不定的言论让政府内外一些对华鹰派人士担心，他可能会改变主意，或把新规当作与习近平谈判的筹码。
周一，当记者问及这一敏感局面时，特朗普坚称卢特尼克“工作做得非常好”。他暗示，之所以推迟对Megaspeed采取行动，是为了避免惹恼习近平。
“如果不推迟，如果你不先做点什么，就可能跟中国闹翻，”特朗普说。他还表示：“我认为你不会想在抵达中国之前就冒犯他们。”
商务部周一上午发布的新规将要求，美国境外的数据中心在向总部位于中国、俄罗斯、伊朗以及少数其他高风险国家的公司出售大量算力之前必须先取得美国政府的许可。官员们表示，这将堵住一个漏洞，此前，中国企业虽然被禁止购买英伟达的先进芯片，却可以通过租用这些芯片获取算力，而这种渠道帮助中国人工智能产业迅速发展。参与相关政策争论的美国官员表示，中国的人工智能模型对美国构成了重大的网络攻击威胁。
宣布这项措施的新闻稿中出现了一句不寻常的话，折射出规定出台背后的争执。商务部表示，新规是“由财政部和国家安全委员会起草，并按照这两个部门的指示制定的”。
新政策将在90天后生效。执行该政策的任务将落到卢特尼克身上，而他是这项措施的坚决反对者。一名接近卢特尼克的人士表示，他曾多次警告总统及其同僚，这些限制可能引发与中国的新一轮贸易战。另一名接近卢特尼克的人士表示，有关财政部和国安会的免责说明，意在明确谁应该为这项在他们看来错误的政策负责。
今年7月，商务部长卢特尼克（右）与英伟达的黄仁勋在白宫椭圆形办公室。卢特尼克一直主张对数据中心实施较为宽松的限制。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times
上周，黄仁勋在公司董事会的压力下辞去了英伟达首席执行官职务。此前，他与公司一名高管及黄乐的关系曝光。美国官员认定，黄乐是中国国家安全部的一名情报线人。黄乐创办了总部位于新加坡的数据中心公司Megaspeed，美国当局正在调查该公司涉嫌向中国走私芯片的指控。（Megaspeed表示，其经营活动合法合规。）
2024年，黄仁勋与黄乐在台湾。黄乐曾担任数据中心公司Megaspeed高管，该公司因涉嫌向中国走私芯片而受到调查。 Ann Wang/Reuters
《纽约时报》此前报道称，特朗普至少两次收到有关黄仁勋这段关系的警告，分别是在去年年底和今年春天。据两名知情美国官员透露，鲁比奥对黄仁勋与黄乐的纠葛深感担忧，在3月30日撰写了一份机密备忘录，概述了显示黄乐与中国最高情报机构存在联系的情报。这些官员说，随后在5月，鲁比奥在“空军一号”总统专机上亲自向特朗普汇报了相关情报。
这些官员表示，有关黄乐的秘密情报在幕后影响了特朗普今年5月的北京之行。黄仁勋最初没有出现在受邀随行的企业高管名单上。但在新闻报道指出他未获邀请后，特朗普给他打了电话，黄仁勋随后前往安克雷奇，在“空军一号”按计划经停时与专机会合。当时，特朗普称有关黄仁勋未获邀请的报道是“假新闻”。
在整场风波中，特朗普始终支持黄仁勋。据《纽约时报》上周报道，总统曾致电黄仁勋，敦促他努力保住职位。周一，特朗普表示，他“不介意”看到黄仁勋复职。“我认为他吸取了一个很大的教训，”特朗普说。
自第二任期开始以来，黄仁勋一直着力与总统建立关系，不仅在公开场合对他大加赞扬，还宣布了多项巨额投资计划，而特朗普将这些投资吹捧为政府政绩。
2025年8月，特朗普允许英伟达恢复向中国出口H20芯片，条件是将销售收入的15%上缴美国政府，但北京方面始终没有批准相关销售。两个月后，英伟达承诺为特朗普的白宫宴会厅项目捐款2500万美元。
12月，特朗普宣布英伟达可向中国出售其更强大的H200芯片，条件是将销售收入的25%交给美国政府。特朗普曾告诉助手，他认为英伟达对美国股市乃至整体经济都至关重要。
财长贝森特一直主张采取更严格的措施限制中国获取先进人工智能芯片。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times
有关数据中心的新规此前已在特朗普政府内部搁置数月。据两名高级官员透露，特朗普早在8月就批准了这项规定，但商务部一直没有发布。拜登政府在卸任前夕曾实施类似限制，特朗普政府去年将其撤销，此后拟定的多个替代方案也都不了了之。
支持对北京采取更强硬立场的现任和前任官员表示，他们希望特朗普周一的言论只是外交辞令，并希望他能落实芯片限制措施，让Megaspeed调查按程序进行下去。
其他曾为总统工作的人则更为怀疑。自2025年5月特朗普在与北京的关税战中作出退让以来，他已向国家安全团队明确表示，自己不愿采取任何可能扰乱美中贸易关系的行动。
于2017年至2018年担任特朗普国家安全顾问的H·R·麦克马斯特在离开政府后一直批评特朗普。他表示，特朗普热衷于达成交易的本能屡屡削弱其对华政策。
“我认为，特朗普总统常常受制于这样一种信念——他能够达成别人都无法达成的协议，”麦克马斯特说。“结果，他非但没有采取一以贯之的政策来应对中国咄咄逼人的经济政策，反而经常摇摆不定，削弱了自己的立场。”

title: 中加达成贸易协议进一步削减关税，两国关系升温
source: 纽约时报中文网 国际纵览
summary: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼与中国领导人习近平周二在深圳会晤。 Adrian Wyld/The Canadian Press, via Associated Press 加拿大总理卡尼和中国领导人习近平达成了一项降低两国间部分关税的协议，这在很大程度上是一个象征性的举措，表明随着加拿大与美国的联系出现动摇，中加两国关系正在回暖。 这项在中国的科技和金融中心深圳达成的协议将使中加贸易规模有所扩大，但增幅有限，仅涉及2.8亿美元的出口。不过，这项协议以及此次显得颇为友好的会晤与卡尼和特朗
content:
加拿大总理马克·卡尼与中国领导人习近平周二在深圳会晤。 Adrian Wyld/The Canadian Press, via Associated Press
加拿大总理卡尼和中国领导人习近平达成了一项降低两国间部分关税的协议，这在很大程度上是一个象征性的举措，表明随着加拿大与美国的联系出现动摇，中加两国关系正在回暖。
这项在中国的科技和金融中心深圳达成的协议将使中加贸易规模有所扩大，但增幅有限，仅涉及2.8亿美元的出口。不过，这项协议以及此次显得颇为友好的会晤与卡尼和特朗普总统的关系形成了鲜明对比。今年早些时候，美加贸易谈判在激烈争吵中破裂后，卡尼曾表示美国正在与加拿大“交战”。
加拿大和美国正在重启谈判，但没有迹象表明华盛顿会在主要摩擦因素上让步，包括对加拿大汽车、钢铁和铝征收高达50%的关税。
自去年进入政界以来，卡尼一直在世界各地周游，致力于使加拿大的经济和政治关系多元化，减少对美国的依赖。这些努力包括目前旨在使加拿大成为欧盟首个准成员国的谈判，以及卡尼今年与习近平的第二次正式会晤。
“双边贸易安排的稳定表明，我们可以在更广泛、更务实的层面上合作解决问题，”卡尼在周二与习近平会晤开始时说。
他还说，加拿大在实现本十年末对华出口增长50%的目标方面进度超前。
加拿大前总理特鲁多领导的加拿大政府效仿拜登政府，对中国制造的电动汽车征收100%的关税，此后中加两国曾陷入贸易战。作为回应，中国对多种加拿大产品征收关税，特别是油料作物油菜籽。
这一争端在今年1月习近平和卡尼的首次正式会晤中基本得到解决。在加拿大同意以极低的关税税率允许相对少量的中国电动汽车进入该国后，中国取消了对油菜籽的关税。
在周二的会晤之前，习近平试图将冰冷的关系彻底留在过去——2018年，中国逮捕了两名加拿大人，以报复加拿大根据美国的引渡请求拘留一名中国电信高管，这使得两国关系进一步恶化。
“中加关系这些年发展历程给我们的重要启示，就是相互尊重、平等互利、求同存异。中方愿同加方一道努力，”习近平在会晤开始时说。
周二的公告将在基本取消对加拿大冷冻猪肉和若干海产品的关税。这两种产品都被卷入了中国对电动汽车的报复行动中。相应地，加拿大将继续暂停对部分中国钢铁和铝产品的关税，这些关税原定于年底到期。加拿大还将扩大暂免关税的产品清单。
一份加拿大政府文件称，自3月以来，中国汽车工厂在4.9万辆的年度配额下向加拿大出口了16211辆汽车。文件称，其中一半汽车的售价低于3.5万加元（约合2.45万美元）。文件还指出，第二家中国汽车制造商的汽车已获得加拿大安全认证。该公司（政府未透露其名称）计划仅销售价格低于3.5万加元的汽车，这正是加拿大的价格上限目标。
周一在柬埔寨金边，卡尼表示，如果无法取消特朗普的关税，加拿大将转向中国、日本和欧洲来拯救其汽车工业。
卡尼和习近平的会晤是在亚太经济合作组织论坛之前举行的，该论坛将于本周晚些时候在深圳举行。
自今年1月在瑞士达沃斯世界经济论坛发表演讲以来，卡尼已成为那些非超级大国的发达经济体国家的代言人，他将这一群体称为“中等强国”。
但亚太经合组织峰会的主要议程将是习近平、特朗普和俄罗斯总统普京之间的会晤。
在此次亚洲之行的早些时候，当被问及这场超级大国峰会时，卡尼重申了加拿大在俄罗斯入侵后对乌克兰的支持。
加拿大官员表示，他们预计特朗普和卡尼不会在深圳会面。卡尼也不太可能与普京会面。他周末表示，他不会抵制包括普京在内的峰会合影，但这仅仅是出于对中国的尊重。

title: 紐西蘭一位市長在訪華後說：民主制度已風光不再

content:
紐西蘭一位市長在訪華後說：民主制度已風光不再 | 國際焦點 | 全球 | 聯合新聞網
Your browser does not support HTML5 Audio! 😢
奧克蘭市長韋恩·布朗（Wayne Brown）在接受媒體「Stuff」採訪時表示，他在訪問中國大城市廣州期間，關注了紐西蘭近期舉行的大選。他說：「我搞不懂紐西蘭現在到底是怎麼回事。」
在週二（11月17日）發表的這篇採訪中，他說：「（紐西蘭的）這套體制讓人費解……再看看美國的選舉……選出了一個根本無法運作的政府。歐洲那邊，也已經很多年沒有像樣的選舉了。」
布朗補充道：「民主制度已經風光不再了。說真的，是時候換種模式了。」
紐西蘭本月舉行了大選，但目前選情膠著，勝負難分。預計在11月27日最終結果公佈後，各方將開始進行組閣談判。
當被問及他所提倡的「替代民主的方案」具體是什麼時，布朗表示，他不想捲入意識形態的討論。
他說：「什麼模式行得通？中國模式就行得通。我是指在經濟增長和實現繁榮富裕方面。」
法新社的報導指出，中國近年來面臨內需疲軟、消費復甦乏力等挑戰，經濟增長速度也較過去明顯放緩。此外，北京還被指控存在廣泛的侵犯人權行為，打壓異議聲音、限制言論自由。
布朗自2022年起擔任奧克蘭市長，他以言辭激烈、常有出格言論而聞名。他這次「民主體制風光不再」的言論招致了美國駐惠靈頓大使館官員賈裡德·諾維利（Jared Novelly）的抨擊。
諾維利在社交平台X上寫道：「我想，要接收情報簡報，紐西蘭政府官員至少得具備一定的智力水準；從這位市長的言論來看，他顯然沒達到這個門檻。」
「美國和紐西蘭之所以能建立起成功的民主制度，靠的絕不是那種『覺得讓民眾參與決策太麻煩』的態度。」
諾維利也在接受紐西蘭國家廣播電台（RNZ）採訪時表示，布朗似乎已經被中國「俘虜」了。他表示，願意與這位市長交流，但又說：「你知道，想要越過他門前那道『紅旗』，恐怕沒那麼容易。」
紐西蘭是「五眼聯盟」情報共享機制的成員國，該聯盟的其他四個成員國是美國、英國、加拿大和澳大利亞。
紐西蘭曾因對中國採取較為溫和的立場而受到批評——被指責把貿易關係置於盟友的安全關切之上。不過近年來，惠靈頓在對華態度上也曾有過公開轉強的時候，例如，8月份一份來自情報機構的報告指控中國從事間諜活動，中國駐紐西蘭大使館則對此予以堅決否認。

content:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普抵达中国深圳宝安国际机场，中国国家主席习近平前往机场迎接。(2026年11月18日)
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)星期三(11月18日)抵达中国深圳，中国国家主席习近平前往机场迎接。特朗普总统将在深圳出席亚太经合组织(APEC)领导人会议，并与习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京(Vladimir Putin)举行历史性的三方峰会，这标志着特朗普总统此次亚洲外交之行的高潮。
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普抵达中国深圳宝安国际机场，中国国家主席习近平前往机场迎接。(2026年11月18日)
特朗普总统在中国当地时间星期三下午4点43分抵达深圳宝安国际机场，中国领导人习近平前往机场迎接。这是习近平就任中国国家主席以来，首次到机场迎接来访的外国领导人。今年9月23日习近平访美时，特朗普总统曾亲赴华盛顿安德鲁斯空军基地迎接。
星期三稍早，俄罗斯总统普京抵达深圳时，到机场迎接他的是中共中央政治局常委、中央书记处书记蔡奇。
特朗普总统将在星期三晚间参加APEC峰会领导人欢迎晚宴，星期四出席APEC领导人峰会后，他将与习近平举行今年以来美中第三次领导人峰会。
美国官员将此次美中领导人峰会主要定位为检视既有承诺的落实情况，而非谈判一项全面的新协议。
美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特(Scott Bessent)上星期二表示，美国希望与中国建立“更加平衡”的经济关系，目标是“去风险，而非脱钩”。
不过，美中双方在稀土供应、农产品采购和关税减让方面仍有分歧，新的科技争端进一步增加了会谈的压力。
美国商务部11月16日宣布新规，针对通过海外数据中心远程获取美国先进芯片和服务器算力的活动加强管制。北京星期二谴责这一措施，称其背离两国领导人达成的共识，并威胁采取反制措施。
美国国务院中文发言人贾博(Jakob Lengacher)星期二在马尼拉接受美国之音记者黄耀毅专访时表示，特朗普总统在中国访问期间，肯定会提到超级智能(通常称人工智能或AI)。
“因为美国政府认为超级智能这个领域具有强大的潜力，也是推动经济增长的最有效措施之一。所以美国在参加东盟峰会有讨论到超级智能，出席APEC，很有可能会讨论到超级智能，因为大家都非常关注这个新型技术。”他说。
特朗普总统星期二表示，他预计中国国家主席习近平会主动向他提出台湾议题。对此，贾博表示，美国重视亚太地区的和平稳定，美国的对台政策保持不变。
“川普总统说他自己不会提的，但是他估计习近平就会提到。美国对台政策保持不变，我们还是要维持现状，反对任何一方单方面改变现状，毕竟美国重视的就是南中国海，甚至整个亚太地区的和平稳定。“贾博说。
星期四在与习近平结束会谈后，特朗普总统将与习近平、普京举行美中俄三方峰会。
特朗普总统星期一在启程前往亚洲时告诉记者，他将与习近平和普京讨论核武器、伊朗以及乌克兰。
“我们将讨论无核化问题。我们会谈到伊朗。伊朗问题目前很好。但我们还是会简单谈谈伊朗。我们将讨论我最喜欢的话题--乌克兰。”他说。
三方峰会还将触及哪些具体议题，美国国务院中文发言人贾博对美国之音表示：“具体的话题现在有点过早说，特朗普总统说，他参加这次三方会面，非常想要讨论无核化问题，因为他非常重视和平。而他认为在实现无核化方面取得一定的进步对维护世界和平，至关重要。”
中国曾多次拒绝特朗普提出的美俄中三方核军控会谈的提议。中国表示，现阶段要求中方参加裁军谈判不公平、不合理，也不可能。中国还提出三方核裁军对话的前提条件是，美国和俄罗斯必须首先大幅削减各自的核武库。
美国官员们也淡化了就核问题达成新协议的可能性，并表示此次会谈将是一个起点。“我们预计不会达成任何协议，”一位美国高级官员表示，“我会将此视为两国领导人之间对话的切入点，是双方领导人之间的首次对话。”
分析人士普遍认为，三方会谈的象征意义大于实际意义，不会有重大突破。
智库新欧亚战略中心研究中俄关系的副研究员阿列克谢·奇加达耶夫(Aleksei Chigadaev)对美国之音说，中国控制了峰会，北京是不会允许任何有关重大谈判或是引人注目的文件出现的。
“也许会发表一份声明或联合声明，探讨为了确保核武器安全，有必要控制人工智能的发展。我认为他们会在这一点上达成共识。”他说。

台湾虎航周四首航故宫博物院主题飞机
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
台湾虎航飞机供图
中新社台北11月18日电 台湾虎航表示，一架印有国立故宫博物院“国宝”文物图案的台湾虎航飞机将于周四首飞日本福冈。
台湾虎航在周三的新闻稿中表示，这架联名涂装飞机是空客 A320neo，其背景设计为《富春山居图》中的山峰。
这幅画是著名的元代水墨纸本手卷，是中国艺术家黄公望为数不多的幸存作品之一。
该航空公司表示，飞机上还装饰有博物馆收藏的其他九件作品的图像，包括著名的“翡翠白菜”和“肉形石”。
台湾虎航董事长黄世辉（右）。中央通讯社照片2026年11月18日
周三，台湾虎航董事长黄世惠在媒体参观飞机机库时指出，2014年10月，位于福冈县的九州国立博物馆成为日本第一家展示台湾国立博物馆藏品的博物馆。
台湾虎航表示，作为合作伙伴关系的一部分，台湾虎航和国立故宫博物院还将推出一系列商品，包括模型飞机，而在博物馆出示台湾虎航登机牌的游客将获得 10% 的入场折扣。
该飞机的首趟商业航班 IT240 将于周四早上 6 点 45 分从桃园机场起飞，并于当地时间上午 10 点抵达福冈。

Tigerair Taiwan to debut National Palace Museum-themed plane Thursday
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Photo courtesy of Tigerair Taiwan airplane
Taipei, Nov. 18 (CNA) A Tigerair Taiwan airplane featuring images of "national treasure" artifacts from the National Palace Museum will make its debut flight to Fukuoka, Japan on Thursday, the budget carrier said.
The co-branded livery aircraft, an Airbus A320neo, features a background design of mountain peaks from the painting Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains, Tigerair Taiwan said in a press release Wednesday.
The painting, a renowned ink-on-paper handscroll from the Yuan dynasty, is one of the few surviving works by Chinese artist Huang Gongwang.
The plane is also decorated with images of nine other pieces from the museum's collection, including the famous "Jadeite Cabbage" and "Meat-Shaped Stone," the carrier said.
Tigerair Taiwan Chairperson Huang Shih-hui (right). CNA photo Nov. 18, 2026
During a media visit to the hangar housing the aircraft Wednesday, Tigerair Taiwan Chairperson Huang Shih-hui (黃世惠) noted that in October 2014, Kyushu National Museum in Fukuoka Prefecture became the first museum in Japan to display items from Taiwan's national museum.
As part of the partnership, Tigerair Taiwan and the National Palace Museum will also launch a range of merchandise, including model airplanes, while visitors presenting a Tigerair Taiwan boarding pass at the museum will receive a 10 percent discount on entry, the airline said.
The aircraft's first commercial flight with its new livery, IT240, will depart Taoyuan Airport at 6:45 a.m. Thursday and arrive in Fukuoka at 10 a.m. local time.

台湾将波兰视为进军欧洲的基地 - 聚焦台湾
专访/台湾将波兰视为进军欧洲的基地
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
经济部长孔明新。中央通讯社照片2026年11月18日
中新社台北11月18日电 台湾经济部部长龚明鑫本周在访问比利时和波兰时表示，台湾正寻求通过复制波兰的制造集群模式来加强与欧洲的供应链联系。
孔先生率领代表团于11月14日至19日出访，周一在布鲁塞尔会见了欧盟委员会内部市场、工业、创业和中小企业总司的官员。
经济部周三在一份声明中表示，会议期间，双方同意通过产业政策对话深化两国在先进制造、人工智能（AI）基础设施和半导体领域的合作。
周二，孔在华沙参加了由经济部和台湾电机电子制造商协会（TEEMA）共同主办的TEEMA科学园工业日。
他表示，在制造业集群的支持下，台湾经济今年预计增长12%以上。
这位部长表示，在波兰复制这一模式将为台湾企业扩展到中欧和东欧以及更广泛的欧洲市场提供基础。
孔认为，计划中的TEEMA科学园、华沙台湾贸易投资服务中心以及政府间经济对话是台湾和波兰计划加强经济关系的三个主要方式。
孔在接受中央社采访时表示，随着全球供应链的转变和人工智能需求的不断增长，波兰已成为对台湾投资越来越有吸引力的目的地。
这位部长表示，波兰拥有约3800万人口、大量工程师和具有竞争力的劳动力成本，具有强大的制造业潜力。
孔认为人工智能和半导体、无人机、电动汽车（EV）和智能城市技术是波兰和台湾可以合作的行业。
TEEMA副主席许介立表示，规划中的工业园占地约150公顷。
第一阶段将占地 50 公顷，位于波兰西南部 Miękinia，重点发展人工智能数据中心、电动汽车、无人机和智慧城市产业。
访问期间，孔还见证了波兰国防工业商会与台湾国防工业发展协会签署军民两用技术合作谅解备忘录。
经济部数据显示，2025年波兰为台湾在欧盟第六大贸易伙伴，双边贸易额达创纪录的25.4亿美元，较上年增长22.4%。
（曾润廷、郑静宇、高旻撰）

Taiwan looks to Poland as base for expansion into Europe - Focus Taiwan
INTERVIEW/Taiwan looks to Poland as base for expansion into Europe
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Minister of Economic Affairs Kung Ming-hsin. CNA photo Nov. 18, 2026
Taipei, Nov. 18 (CNA) Taiwan is seeking to strengthen its supply chain ties with Europe by replicating its manufacturing cluster model in Poland, Minister of Economic Affairs Kung Ming-hsin (龔明鑫) said during a visit to Belgium and Poland this week.
Kung, who is leading a delegation on a Nov. 14-19 trip, met with officials from the European Commission's Directorate-General for Internal Market, Industry, Entrepreneurship and SMEs in Brussels on Monday.
During the meeting, the two sides agreed to deepen cooperation in advanced manufacturing, artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure and semiconductors through talks on industrial policy, the Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) said in a statement Wednesday.
On Tuesday, Kung attended TEEMA Science Park Industry Day in Warsaw, co-hosted by the MOEA and the Taiwan Electrical and Electronic Manufacturers' Association (TEEMA).
He said Taiwan's economy is projected to grow by more than 12 percent this year, supported by its manufacturing clusters.
Replicating that model in Poland would give Taiwanese companies a base for expanding into Central and Eastern Europe and the broader European market, the minister said.
Kung identified the planned TEEMA Science Park, the Taiwan Trade and Investment Service Center in Warsaw, and government-to-government economic talks as three main ways Taiwan and Poland plan to strengthen economic ties.
In an interview with CNA, Kung said Poland has become an increasingly attractive destination for Taiwanese investment amid shifts in global supply chains and growing demand for AI.
With a population of about 38 million, a large pool of engineers and competitive labor costs, Poland has strong manufacturing potential, the minister said.
Kung identified AI and semiconductors, drones, electric vehicles (EVs) and smart city technologies as industries in which Poland and Taiwan could work together.
TEEMA Vice Chairman Jerry Hsu (許介立) said the planned industrial park will cover about 150 hectares.
The first phase will cover 50 hectares in Miękinia in southwestern Poland and will focus on AI data centers, EVs, drones and smart city industries.
During the visit, Kung also witnessed the signing of a memorandum of understanding between Poland's Chamber of Commerce for the Defence Industry and Taiwan's Defense Industry Development Association to work together on dual-use technologies.
According to the MOEA, Poland was Taiwan's sixth-largest trading partner in the European Union in 2025, with bilateral trade reaching a record US$2.54 billion, up 22.4 percent from the previous year.

亚洲首例东台湾蝴蝶被贴上微型发射器标签
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
周三，研究人员在花莲县的一只马利筋蝴蝶身上安装了蝴蝶追踪器。中央通讯社照片2026年11月18日
中新社台北11月18日电 东纵谷国家风景区管理处周三表示，研究昆虫迁徙模式的研究人员在台湾东部的两只蝴蝶上用0.06克微发射器标记，实现了亚洲首例。
旅游局总部在一份新闻稿中表示，它已与保护组织合作，启动了针对两种马利筋蝴蝶（小乌鸦和深蓝虎）的电子标记和跟踪项目。
总部表示，该项目包括为蝴蝶安装太阳能微型发射器，通过 2.4 兆赫无线信号传输数据，手机可以通过蓝牙检测到这些信号。
太阳能微发射器的样本。中央通讯社照片2026年11月18日
总部副主任洪肇昌表示，该项目旨在弥补以往蝴蝶迁徙研究中的空白，即依靠人工标记和重新捕获，从而产生碎片化、不连续的记录。
洪说，这项新技术使研究人员能够重复检测同一只蝴蝶，并跟踪其从羽化到死亡的整个生命周期的运动。
台湾昆虫栖息地保护协会会长詹家龙在花莲县寿丰乡鲤鱼潭游客中心举行的宣传活动上表示，乌蝶在冬季迁徙到台湾南部温暖的山谷，之前通过人工标记记录了它们的路线。
陈说，在新项目中，一只小乌鸦蝴蝶和一只深蓝色老虎安装了发射器来记录它们的迁徙路线。
总部鼓励公众下载 iOS 版“Project Monarch Science”应用程序或 Android 版“Project Monarch”应用程序，并在手机上启用蓝牙和定位服务，参与公民科学倡议。
当标记的蝴蝶在蓝牙检测范围内飞行时，应用程序用户可以检测并记录它们的动作。总部表示，参与者可以提交照片，以及蝴蝶的识别号码以及每次目击的时间和地点，以帮助研究人员建立用于保护研究的数据库。
公民科学是指公众或业余爱好者参与和协作科学研究。
Chan 补充说，两年前在美国进行了一个类似的项目，当时为 400 只帝王蝶安装了微型发射器，以追踪它们从北美到墨西哥的迁徙。

East Taiwan butterflies tagged with tiny transmitters in Asian first
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Researchers put a butterfly tracker on a milkweed butterfly in Hualien County on Wednesday. CNA photo Nov. 18, 2026
Taipei, Nov. 18 (CNA) Researchers studying insect migration patterns have achieved an Asian first by tagging two butterflies in east Taiwan with 0.06 gram microtransmitters, the East Longitudinal Valley National Scenic Area Headquarters said Wednesday.
In a news release, the headquarters, part of the Tourism Administration, said it had teamed up with conservation groups to launch the electronic tagging and tracking project for two species of milkweed butterflies, the small crow and dark blue tiger.
The project involves fitting butterflies with solar-powered microtransmitters that transmits data through 2.4-gigahertz wireless signals that can be detected by mobile phones via Bluetooth, the headquarters said.
A sample of a solar-powered microtransmitter. CNA photo Nov. 18, 2026
Hung Chao-chang (洪肇昌), deputy director of the headquarters, said the project aims to address gaps in previous butterfly migration research, which relied on manual tagging and recapture and therefore produced fragmented, discontinuous records.
The new technology allows researchers to repeatedly detect the same butterfly and track its movements throughout its life cycle, from emergence to death, Hung said.
Speaking at a promotional event at the Liyu Lake Visitor Center in Shoufeng Township, Hualien County, Taiwan Insect Habitat Protection Association President Chan Chia-lung (詹家龍) said crow butterflies migrate to warmer valleys in southern Taiwan during winter, with their routes previously documented through manual marking.
For the new project, one small crow butterfly and one dark blue tiger have been fitted with transmitters to record their migration routes, Chan said.
The headquarters encouraged the public to take part in the citizen science initiative by downloading the "Project Monarch Science" app for iOS or "Project Monarch" for Android, and enabling Bluetooth and location services on their phones.
When tagged butterflies fly within Bluetooth detection range, their movements can be detected and recorded by app users. Participants can then submit photographs, along with the butterflies' identification numbers and the time and location of each sighting, to help researchers build a database for conservation studies, the headquarters said.
Citizen science refers to public or amateur participation and collaboration in scientific research.
Chan added that a similar project was conducted in the United States two years ago, when micro-transmitters were fitted to 400 monarch butterflies to track their migration from North America to Mexico.

台湾核公投前能源安全争议 - 聚焦台湾
台湾核公投前的能源安全和安全争论
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中央选举委员会供图
中新社台北11月18日电 在台湾11月28日就结束无核能源政策进行公投之前，周三，一名支持核的立法者和一名反对重启核反应堆的地质学家在电视演讲中就能源安全、电力成本和地震风险发生争执。
演讲中，台湾人民党立委洪毓祥表示支持该提案，而台湾地热协会常务理事王守诚表示反对。
这是中央选举委员会就全民投票问题组织的五场电视演讲中的第四场：“你是否支持政府利用核能振兴经济并废除‘无核家园’能源政策？”
此次公投由主要反对党国民党提出，并得到TPP的支持，但遭到执政的民进党（DPP）的反对。
洪宣扬核电批评民进党能源政策
洪说，核电对于提供稳定的低碳电力至关重要，以满足台湾半导体和人工智能（AI）行业不断增长的电力需求。
洪说：“一个国家的实力取决于其计算能力，而计算能力又取决于电力。”他援引政府预测，未来十年电力需求将平均每年增长2.5%。
他补充说：“这是过去十年平均增长率的两倍多，台湾每年需要增加超过 70 亿千瓦时的电力。”
洪指责民进党未能实现其可再生能源目标，导致电价上涨并继续严重依赖化石燃料。
他还批评民进党政府尽管长期以来致力于逐步淘汰核电，但仍考虑重启此前关闭的核反应堆，尽管该党敦促选民拒绝公投提案。
洪说：“这种180度的转变根本没有意义。”他认为政府立场的转变让公众感到困惑。
在能源安全方面，洪说，台湾对进口液化天然气的依赖使其在台海封锁时很容易受到供应中断的影响。
他说：“保留核电意味着维持最后一道防线，防止威胁国家安全的停电。”他认为，与天然气不同，核燃料可以储存多年。
王警告地质风险和核电重启成本高昂
国立台湾海洋大学研究员王反驳说，台湾地震多发地区核电站的地质灾害尚未得到充分解决，并指出设施下方或附近的断层结构。
王说：“地震、台风和断层不会因为公投而消失。”他辩称，政府和台电的报告已经确定了所有四个核电站厂址的地质风险。
他特别提到了屏东县的马鞍山核电站，声称两座反应堆都位于不稳定的地质结构上，台电最近钻探的五个钻孔揭示了断层剪切带。

【原文 English Original】
Energy security, safety debated ahead of Taiwan's nuclear referendum - Focus Taiwan
Energy security, safety debated ahead of Taiwan's nuclear referendum
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Photo courtesy of the Central Election Commission
Taipei, Nov. 18 (CNA) A pro-nuclear lawmaker and a geologist opposed to restarting nuclear reactors sparred Wednesday over energy security, electricity costs and earthquake risks during a televised presentation ahead of Taiwan's Nov. 28 referendum on ending the country's nuclear-free energy policy.
The presentation featured Taiwan People's Party (TPP) Legislator Hung Yu-hsiang (洪毓祥) arguing in favor of the proposal and Wang Shou-cheng (王守誠), a standing director of the Taiwan Geothermal Association, speaking against it.
It was the fourth of five televised presentations organized by the Central Election Commission on the referendum question: "Do you support the government revitalizing the economy with nuclear energy and abolishing the 'nuclear-free homeland' energy policy?"
The referendum was proposed by the main opposition Kuomintang and backed by the TPP, but opposed by the ruling Democratic Progressive Party (DPP).
Hung touts nuclear power, criticizes DPP energy policy
Hung said nuclear power was essential to providing stable, low-carbon electricity to meet growing electricity demand from Taiwan's semiconductor and artificial intelligence (AI) industries.
"A country's strength depends on its computing power, which in turn depends on electricity," Hung said, citing government forecasts that electricity demand would grow by an average of 2.5 percent annually over the next decade.
"This is more than double the average growth rate over the past decade, with Taiwan needing over 7 billion additional kilowatt-hours of electricity each year," he added.
Hung accused the DPP of failing to meet its renewable energy targets, allowing electricity prices to rise and continuing to rely heavily on fossil fuels.
He also criticized the DPP government for considering restarting previously shut-down nuclear reactors despite its longstanding commitment to phasing out nuclear power, even as the party urged voters to reject the referendum proposal.
"This 180-degree turn simply makes no sense," Hung said, arguing that the government's shifting position had left the public confused.
On energy security, Hung said Taiwan's dependence on imported liquefied natural gas made it vulnerable to supply disruptions in the event of a blockade of the Taiwan Strait.
"Keeping nuclear power means maintaining a last line of defense against power outages that threaten national security," he said, arguing that nuclear fuel could be stored for years, unlike natural gas.
Wang warns of geological risks, high nuclear restart costs
Wang, a researcher at National Taiwan Ocean University, countered that geological hazards at nuclear power plants in earthquake-prone Taiwan had not been adequately addressed, citing fault structures beneath or near the facilities.
"Earthquakes, typhoons and faults do not disappear because of a referendum," Wang said, arguing that government and Taiwan Power Co. (Taipower) reports had identified geological risks at all four nuclear plant sites.
He singled out the Maanshan Nuclear Power Plant in Pingtung County, claiming that both reactors were located on unstable geological structures and that five boreholes recently drilled by Taipower had revealed fault shear zones.
Wang also questioned the feasibility of restarting aging reactors, arguing that replacing old equipment and completing safety inspections could cost several hundred billion New Taiwan dollars and take at least five to 10 years.
He also argued that Taiwan lacked a domestic nuclear power industry supply chain and relied on imported technology and equipment, meaning that restarting aging reactors would require customized components for repairs and upgrades.
Citing California's Diablo Canyon Nuclear Power Plant, Wang said extending its operations by five years could cost as much as NT$390 billion (US$11.8 billion), illustrating the engineering challenges and high costs of extending nuclear reactors' operating lives.
The Maanshan nuclear plant in Pintung County. CNA file photo
Taiwan shut down its last operating reactor at the Maanshan plant on May 17, 2025, fulfilling a longstanding pledge by the DPP, which has been in power since 2016, to phase out nuclear power.
On March 21, President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) said the Ministry of Economic Affairs had determined that the Maanshan plant and the No. 2 Nuclear Power Plant in New Taipei's Wanli District met the requirements to begin the reactor restart process.
The president cited rising electricity demand driven by AI, the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism and growing geopolitical risks, while reaffirming his support for renewable energy.
On Sept. 24, the Nuclear Safety Commission approved Taipower's plan to restart the Maanshan plant, although further safety assessments are required before the plant can resume operations.
The fifth and final presentation will be held at 7 p.m. Friday, with pro-nuclear power activist Huang Shih-hsiu (黃士修) speaking in favor of the referendum and Teng Yu-yu (鄧宇佑), a spokesperson for Citizens of the Earth, Taiwan, speaking against it.

content:
欧盟商会主席：机器人无法解决台湾出生率下降问题 - 焦点台湾
欧盟商会主席：机器人无法解决台湾出生率下降问题
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
台湾欧洲商会主席 Frank Grunert（左）与国家发展委员会叶俊贤部长。中央通讯社照片2026年11月17日
中新社台北11月18日电 台湾欧盟商会(ECCT)主席弗兰克·格鲁纳特(Frank Grunert)周三表示，随着劳动力萎缩，台湾应该给予在职父母更大的灵活性，并让外国专业人士更容易留下来，并警告称，仅靠自动化无法抵消出生率下降的影响。
Grunert 在商会 2027 年立场文件的发布中表示，人工智能 (AI) 的繁荣推动了半导体和数据中心设备行业比其他行业更快的增长。
他表示，帮助这些其他行业增长将使台湾不易受到人工智能投资下滑的影响。
“答案不是更多的机器人，”格鲁纳特说。 “机器人不住在公寓里，机器人也不吃食物。”
内政部数据显示，10 月份台湾人口连续第 34 个月下降。该部门当月的出生人数为 8,035 人，比去年同期减少 1,423 人，相当于年化粗出生率为每 1,000 人 4.08 人。
对于在职父母，商会呼吁提供更慷慨的休假津贴、更多远程或兼职工作选择，以及针对儿童保育的额外税收优惠。
为了留住外籍专业人士，格鲁纳特建议以三年工作许可为合格专业人士的标准，并允许他们在工作结束后留在台湾寻找新的工作。
该商会还呼吁，当雇主使用人工智能筛选求职者或评估员工时，定期进行偏见检查和有意义的人为监督。它表示，自动化系统不应独立做出对工人产生不利影响的决策。
代表政府接收文件的国家发展委员会部长叶俊显强调了旨在改善外国专业人士就业、居住和社会保障的修正案。
在人工智能治理方面，叶说，内阁于 6 月成立了国家战略委员会，以协调各部委的政策，并正在制定人工智能风险分类框架。
他敦促商会帮助推进台湾与欧洲之间关于投资保护和避免双重征税的协议。
根据商会的介绍，新论文从 25 个 ECCT 委员会提出了 237 个问题，其中包括 96 个新问题，而上一版的问题为 190 个。
被列为至少五年未解决的问题包括父母的远程工作、外国专业人士的签证和工作许可要求，以及老年外国居民的公共交通折扣票价。
商会的书面审查认为八个问题已完全解决。另外 17 个已取得足够的进展，可以被删除，而 20 个已部分解决并再次提出。
商会延续了上届会议中 121 个未解决的问题，而其委员会则撤回了 23 个问题。
商会报告了上一版中提出的 23% 问题的进展情况。
格鲁纳特称这个数字“非常可观”，并表示在过去十年中，商会通常每年在大约 20% 至 25% 的问题上取得进展。
